Name: State Line Campground
Description: 8 free BLM camping spots with pit toilets. Limited LTE service from solar powered booster station. One of the eight spots is reserved for tent only.

Name: White Pocket
Description: Sleeping place right in front of the White Pocket on the parking. Super quiet, 0 Services. Ideal for morning and sunset photos! In case you are unlucky in the lottery for „the wave“ - this is the place to visit. It is just wonderful here, no permits required, you can stay overnight. Wonder around and enjoy. The last 9 km is deep sand, 4x4 required, high clearance as well. We made it with a Sprinter. It is a remote place.

Location: Tolsona River RV Park and Campground, United States
Name: Tolsona River RV Park and Campground
Description: An old standby for us. Multiple sites for large or small RV's and tents along a windy creek. Hot showers cost .25/minute, wifi close to office.

Location: Beverly Beach State Park, United States
Name: Beverly Beach State Park
Description: This is a great campground for a first night on the Oregon coast. It is a very nice State Park campground with great beach access under a highway 101 overpass. A beautiful old growth loop-system campground with full hookups, tent sites (good selection), hot showers, clean bathrooms, but no wifi available.

Location: Sunset Bay State Park, United States
Name: Sunset Bay State Park
Description: Another night, another campground. Full hookups, hot showers, no wifi. Price: $21/tent site

Location: Clam Beach County Park, United States
Name: Clam Beach County Park
Description: This is a very small campground for cars and RVs. Paved lot right by the ocean with toilets (a bit scary), and a picnic site. Maximum stay is 3 nights and fees were $30/night. There appears to be a camp host across the road. Verizon good. AT&T good. Water available.

Name: Doran County Park
Description: Busy campground on a spit outside of Bodega Bay, CA. Reservations are required for camping due to pandemic. Cost for a basic (no hook-ups) site is $37/night + $4.44 taxes + $9.50 "reservation fee". $7 if you want to use the dump station. Flush toilets, pay for hot showers, no wifi but good Verizon coverage. Lots of day-use folks on sunny days. Water is potable but tastes salty/bad.

Name: KOA Chula Vista
Description: Stayed dec 30 &31 and paid $50 for the first night. The second night was supposed to be $90 but the super nice staff gave it to us for $65. It was a huge splurge but we had been sick and in rain for a week and just wanted nice facilities. Thus place was amazing! Dare I say even worth the price? Fenced dog park, trails,one mile to the beach, super clean facilities, garbage pickup at your site, tons of activities for kids, pool, hot tub, laundry, store but best of all perhaps THE best staff of any place of any kind we have ever stayed. Every single employee was friendly and efficient and went out of their way to be helpful- truly wonderful.

Location: Willard Bay State Park, United States
Name: Willard Bay State Park
Description:
State park with pull through at campsites. $20 per site. Pretty view of the lake. Lots of freeway and train noise. There is a second campground adjacent that has hookups for rvs.
Note: GPS Coordinates have been updated. Location is now correct: 41.41994, -112.054806. This park in is Utah, just off Highway 15.

Location: The Cove at Fish Lake, United States
Name: The Cove at Fish Lake
Description:
A great spot to go camping for the weekend, rent a boat and go fishing. There are lots of established campsites. Few sites have hookups, be sure to make a reservation if you need them.

$30/h for motorboat, $40/h for pontoon.
$20 dry camping, $35 with hookups.

showers are coin-operated. Good cell reception

Name: Wolf Gap Campground
Description: This is a beautiful free campground on the border of Virginia and West Virginia. There are ten sites, each with a picnic table, a BBQ pit, a fire pit, a large tent pad, and a parking spot. There is also a large parking lot for extra vehicles or for day use. The day use area has several BBQ pits and tables. There are also pit toilets, and a water spigot, although we didn't check if it worked since we always carry plenty just incase. Two trail heads start at this site. It is located about 55 minutes NW of Luray on the 675. The road in is good, but narrow and winding. Very beautiful. You can stay for free up to 21 days! US National Forests are amazing. The photos we've included are of different sites. The blue dot on the screenshot is Wolf Gap, the green marker is Luray, VA, for reference. No generators, please. Keep this peaceful place peaceful.

Location: Trout Pond Recreational Area, United States
Name: Trout Pond Recreational Area
Description: Excellent campground with good facilities. Nearby hiking opportunities and very few people in the colder months. Great lake for boating or fishing.

Location: Rocky Gap State Park, United States
Name: Rocky Gap State Park
Description: Great campground open year-round. Most people stay at the casino which is nowhere near the campground. Campground is very peaceful during the colder months. Excellent hiking and recreational opportunities at the site.

Location: Patapsco Valley State Park - Hollofield Campground, United States
Name: Patapsco Valley State Park - Hollofield Campground
Description: Great campground near Baltimore. Place can be crowded at times, and a little noisy, but all in all good place to stay so close to a populated area. Some good hiking and epic mountain biking nearby.

Name: Liberty Campground
Description:
Free. BLM campground at the head of the Liberty / Table Mountain 4WD trail system. Vault toilets that are well maintained. No water or hookups. There are 15 campsites total.

The homeowners a few hundred yards east on Liberty Road sell ice.

Name: Palmer State Fairgrounds
Description: Gated fairgrounds, full hook ups

Name: Browns Lake
Description: Located on Browns lake. Sate camp site with fees and can be busy during the week end. During the week however it can be almost deserted.

Name: Brandywine Group Campground
Description: Great group area near main facilities. Large swimming area and secluded camping spot.

Name: South Ruby Campground
Description:
$15 per camping unit. Nice views.
I’m April of 2025 I found the sites to be $8 per night. I was the only one here so super quiet and clean. Never saw the pit toilets but there are toilets down on Browns Dike.

Location: Mountain View RV Ranch, United States
Name: Mountain View RV Ranch
Description: Close to the border, former KOA, friendly staff. $29 plus tax for full hook up. Spent the evening watching Monday night football on the aging big screen TV with the camp host Charles. Also available is propane, small store with beer, and coin op laundry.

Name: Guajome Regional Park
Description:
Cheapest camping you will find anywhere near Carlsbad or San Diego, and we didn't need reservations in the summer (everywhere else is full). Extremely clean, pay hot showers, full hookups. Now $29 USD.

Tent, RV, van, camper trick, CABIN Available! Established city run & maintained park with full hookups, dump station, recreation abound! Booked 2 nights, will update upon stay!

Park office 760-724-4489 reservations 877-565-3600

Name: Essence Of Tranquility
Description: Hot tubs (artesian) and camping or cabins. Also a communal kitchen and Rec room. Fee includes soaks, showers, use of facilities. Super highspeed wifi for those who work remote

Location: The Mill Casino & RV Park, United States
Name: The Mill Casino & RV Park
Description:
This casino is just outside of Coos Bay, Oregon, and has RV park camping ($65+/night). The RV camping has nice paved spots with a bit of green space and picnic tables. Water and Electricity is available at each RV spot. There are nice clean washrooms, showers, and laundromat with access to the hotel pool and hot tub, and a small frontage store selling bare essentials. Restaurants are in the Casino, and be sure to check the local deals at the casino restaurants as they have different buffets a couple times a week.

T-Mo Reception: 3bars & LTE (fast)

Location: Jedediah Smith State Park, United States
Name: Jedediah Smith State Park
Description:
Note - no facilities available out of season
Although this campsite was $35.00/night, it was beautiful. At that price (with no electricity at the sites) some would say it was overpriced, but you are in the heart of the Redwood forest! It was quiet, and so serene. There are warm showers ($0.50/5 min) and running water in the washrooms. The water from the taps along the campsite loops was drinkable as well. There is a short nature walk that takes you through the Redwood glades and then along the bank of the Smith River. The River also has a day-use area and beach that was pretty cool as well. The water is crystal clear, and we spent some time at the Day-use area swimming once we had reached the noon check-out time. The sneaky idea is to make sure you do not pass through the park exit before going to the day use. The Campground also sells firewood and has great pits for mingling with your neighbors after dark.

Name: Hot Well Dunes
Description: This is a BLM site with a $3 per night fee. Includes pit toilets, picnic tables, trash cans and two hot spring outdoor HOT TUBS!! Spaces are dispersed in the desert sand and privacy is easy to find. Hot tubs fill from solar pump so only hot/flowing during the day. The tubs are empty at sunset. Great location, great price.

Location: Fort Stevens State Park, United States
Name: Fort Stevens State Park
Description:
MUST HAVE RESERVATIONS AS OF 1/1/25

Got a spot! We arrived late at 9:00pm and checked the information board at the welcome center. They had a list of available sites posted up. We did self check in and slept in our car. It was wonderful! Sure, it is pricey at $35/ night, but the Oregon coast doesn't seem to have many pull out spots, so we were grateful for this awesome spot! The walking trails, beach and shipwreck were AMAZING! Such a great spot!

Location: Trailers Inn RV Park, United States
Name: Trailers Inn RV Park
Description: Stayed in 31-S which fits up to 20 feet. USD 46.30 for full hook up. Wifi is now upgraded so was fast. Don’t expect friendly reception. rest was okay being only 12 miles from downtown price is for the location not view. Small book exchange, TV room next to office. Toilets clean.

Name: Bussey Point Campground
Description:
Enjoy nature at its finest. Located at the entrance of Bussey Point wilderness recreation area- a 2,545 acre peninsula on J. Strom Thurmond Lake- the campground provides a relaxing getaway for the nature enthusiast for hiking, mountain biking, or horseback riding. The Bussey Point horse trail was created by horseback riders for horseback riders. This trail circles the peninsula and is 12.5 miles long. Along with the horse trail, there are an additional 20 miles of roads and trails located within the area that all are welcome to use (no motor vehicles please). Located within the area are 15 food plots, six hike/bike/ride/boat in camping/picnic sites, and several natural beaches. Ample deer and turkey inhabit the area along wiht other mammals and birds to provide on of the best opportunities on teh lake to view wildlife in its natural setting. Adjacent to the area is the campground with 14 primitive campsites without water or electic, however, there are picnic tables, fire rings, and grills located at each site. There is also a boat launching ramp, hand pump for drinking water, and rustic toilets locatd throughout the area. 
Camping fee is $10 per night per site and day use is free. There are restrooms on site, but no showers.

Location: Magnolia Springs State Park, United States
Name: Magnolia Springs State Park
Description: Primitive, prepared and RV sites available. Full capability cabins are available. See website for nightly cost (2014 cost $20 for tent walk in and $28 for site with electric).

Name: Crazy Horse Campground
Description:
Crazy Horse RV Resort is a clean, full-service RV park located in the heart of Kanab, Utah — the perfect basecamp for exploring Southern Utah’s most popular destinations, including Zion National Park, Bryce Canyon, Coral Pink Sand Dunes, and the Grand Canyon North Rim.

We offer spacious full-hookup RV sites with 30/50 amp service, along with tent sites, a heated swimming pool, clean bathhouse, and 24/7 laundry facilities. Our location provides easy access to downtown Kanab, local UTV trails, hiking, and sightseeing.

In addition to RV and tent camping, we offer unique lodging options including Luxury Conestoga Wagons, Yurts, and spacious Apartments large enough for the whole family, making Crazy Horse a great option for groups traveling together.

Whether you're staying for a night or planning a longer visit, Crazy Horse RV Resort offers comfort, convenience, and a central location for exploring everything Southern Utah has to offer.

Pull-Through RV Sites
Daily: $59.95 + tax
Weekly: $359.70 + tax

Back-In RV Sites
Daily: $55.00 + tax
Weekly: $330.00 + tax
Monthly (Oct–Jan Only): Starting at $795 – $895 + electric

Tent Pricing: $30.00 Per Night + Tax

Dumping Station: $10 Dump Only / Dump and Water $30

Bathhouse: Showers are $10

Name: Anza Borrego - NICE
Description:
Free camping in Anza Borrego Park. Great stop along the highway - the sites are tucked away enough so the traffic noise is minimal. Sites are well dispersed and private with fire rings and pit toilets. Beautiful desert scenery with diverse landscape. Decent cell phone coverage.

You can drive in with 2WD but need 4WD to get the spots further in. Appears to be gravel with not too much difficulty with 2WD. We almost got our ProMaster stuck. Be careful!

Name: Spencer Hot Springs
Description:
Sweet hot springs with 3 pools. Lots of places for vehicle or tent camping with good views.
Several pools, the one in the center can be somewhat adjusted temperature- wise.
Roads leading fhere are 2wd dirt roads and should be easy unless wet.

Name: Burr Trail - NICE
Description:
Very quiet sleeping places on the Burr Trail to Boulder on a BLM road. Only saw trucks and vans as road is extremely uneven. RV 24 ft max due to the overhang at the entrance.

Tons of good camping off the Burr Trail once you've entered Grand Staircase-Escalante. All BLM. Just dirt roads and fire rings. There is vegetation and hills so still very private. It's sandy — use caution if it's rainy, the clay turns to butter.

Location: Coral Pink Sand Dunes - OK, United States
Name: Coral Pink Sand Dunes - OK
Description: Free camping without nothing in the BLM area. But you can also everywhere else camped nearby! Price: Free

Location: Egan Creat Trail System Recreation Area, United States
Name: Egan Creat Trail System Recreation Area
Description:
Recreation Area with NO "no camping" or "no overnight" signs. Although right off the highway, it's pretty quiet. 2 shelters with tables and garbage cans. A couple of trails to hike, OHV or MTB.
Free

Name: Elyn - OK
Description: Sleeping area in NF. Was super quiet here, albeit cold.

Location: Lake Mead RA - NICE, United States
Name: Lake Mead RA - NICE
Description: Nice place outside the Lake Mead Recreation Area between the Valley of Fire and Las Vegas on a 4x4 route slightly away from the main road. Very quiet, aircraft can be heard sometimes.

Name: Salton Sea - OK
Description: Sleeping place behind a palm tree at the Salton Sea. You can sleep anywhere here beside the road. Is not especially beautiful, but good starting point for the Salton Sea bird watching.

Location: Schlafplatz vor Vegas - OK, United States
Name: Schlafplatz vor Vegas - OK
Description: Sleeping place on a gravel road just before Vegas in NF. One has to go back there since before the site belongs to a camp. Was very quiet, even when not specifically just beautiful. Weak cell signal.

Location: Smokey Mountain Rd - NICE, United States
Name: Smokey Mountain Rd - NICE
Description:
Very nice place on top of the cliff with great views! Large area with awesome view, fire ring. Permit for overnight stay is not necessary.

Smokey Mountains Road/Kelly Grade to this point is in sections very steep, but a great experience. Don't attempt too soon after rain storm as road can get slick. Curvy shelf road all the way to top of Kelly Grade.

Quiet and beautiful. Certainly often windy, but luckily there's no wind at night. Weak signals.

Location: BLM Free Camping West of Zion, United States
Name: BLM Free Camping West of Zion
Description: Sleeping place just off the main road on well marked road. Big rigs welcome. Warm according to circumstances but quiet at night. Verizon decent, good t-mobile. Good 5G internet on my phone.

Location: National Forest Outside Durango, United States
Name: National Forest Outside Durango
Description: Free. Great quiet camping in canyon next to river. National forest. At end of First Fork road (12 miles on a good dirt road), a few miles east of Durango on the way to Pagosa Springs. Trails.

Location: National Forest outside Ouray, United States
Name: National Forest outside Ouray
Description: Beautiful mountain scenery along this 40 mile dirt road which crosses Owl Creek mountain pass, between Ridgway and Montrose. Cold at night. No facilities, free. Plenty of boondocking opportunities.

Location: National Forest outside Crested Butte, United States
Name: National Forest outside Crested Butte
Description:
Free. Beautiful mountain scenery, 15 minutes on dirt road outside town of Crested Butte along Kebler Pass Road. Dirt road but easy to get here in a class C. Kebler Pass Road is a thoroughfare and there's a lot of traffic on the road.

Gorgeous view to Beckwith Mountain. Easy trail down to the river. There are more campsites at Horse Ranch Park and the Cliff Creek Trailhead just northwest of the GPS marker. Horse Ranch has a pit toilet.

Wildlife includes black bears, elk, beaver, and deer. Mosquitoes were relentless — never camp here without preparation.

Location: National Forest outside Glenwood Springs, United States
Name: National Forest outside Glenwood Springs
Description: Free. National Forest camping off a dirt road, with good views in all directions. Quiet, only sound you hear are distant cows. No facilities.

Location: Flaming Gorge national Forest, United States
Name: Flaming Gorge national Forest
Description: Free wild camping in Flaming Gorge. Great mountain scenery.

Name: Big Run Falls
Description: This is a primitive site located along a forest road in Monongahela National Forest. The forest road is graded in sections, but is unimproved in other sections. Four-wheel drive may not be required, but is strongly recommended. The site is marked by a fire circle, and a large, deteriorating picnic table. There is room for roughly a half dozen vehicles, or a couple of modately-sized off-road campers. While we've never encountered other campers there, it is evidently a popular spot. It is a superb destination for hiking, biking, and exploring. There are a number of amazing waterfalls in the immediate vicinity.

Location: Cherry Tree Hunter's Camp, United States
Name: Cherry Tree Hunter's Camp
Description: Small open area in the forest, no creeks or other water sources. Has a quality fire ring, and plenty of space for tents. thick pine canopy stops underbrush from growing too thick. Really pleasant campsite.

Name: Cal Anderson Park
Description: We rolled into Capitol Hill, Seattle thinking that it would be easy to poach a spot on the street, only to find that the streets were all over crowded with bumper to bumper parking. We did find the Gold mine though - Cal Anderson Park, just off of Broadway and Pike Street - One of the places where Grunge Rock started. Cal Anderson park was nominated for some kind of "wholesome award" and was indeed a fantastic place to park for the night (in small Camper Van style -Not a place for big rigs). The pay parking ends at 20:00 and then it is free until 08:00 weekdays and weekends. It is located right beside the park itself which has a well lit Soccer field (lights out around 23:00), Tennis courts, basketball, a walking area, and is well used by Seattle-ites. There are some fantastic pubs like The Unicorn, or Nuemo's (Nirvana played there) a couple blocks away on Pike Street. The parking spots are Back in- Horizontal spots, so again- No Big rigs (Sorry).

Location: Devil's Half Acre Meadow, United States
Name: Devil's Half Acre Meadow
Description: Primitive road. One fire pit. Enough space for multiple tents and vehicles. Big open meadow. Another area across the road as well. Road is closed during the snow season. Not recommended for anything bigger than a 170 sprinter.

Location: Near Batty Pass Caves, United States
Name: Near Batty Pass Caves
Description: Near the base of Fifty-Mile mountain. Two large, flat, primitive sites can accommodate fairly large groups, plus there is another site farther down with less flat space. This location is very near Batty Pass caves, three old rancher caves worth visiting if you are in the area. This location is also near (on the other side of the Hole-in-the-Rock road) Peek-a-boo and Spooky gulches (part of the upper end of Coyote gulch), two popular, short, and excellent non-technical slot canyons. Dogs are allowed in this location, but note that if you are here for Coyote Gulch features, dogs are not allowed there.

Name: West of Blanding
Description: Very scenic overlook.

Location: Near Robsons Mining World, United States
Name: Near Robsons Mining World
Description:
Permits needed for overnight stay.

A desert camping location that is tucked back in the trees. Dry camp. The nearby attraction has a restaurant with limited hours. Interesting glimpse into mining life.

Location: Snyder Hill, West Side-Tucson, AZ, United States
Name: Snyder Hill, West Side-Tucson, AZ
Description: This is a piece of BLM land northeast of the junction of San Joaquin Rd and W Ajo Highway. To the southwest of Tuscon. The area is accessed from the San Joaquin Rd and is criss-crossed with gravel tracks. It is fairly level and covered in small desert trees and bushes so it is possible to remain unseen from the adjacent roads if your vehicle is not too high. It is also possible to pitch a tent as there was one here at the same time as me. There are no facilities whatsoever and traffic noise can be heard from the Ajo 86 Highway. The use of the site is free. T-Mobile 5G service.

Location: Agua Fria National Monument, United States
Name: Agua Fria National Monument
Description: Lots of areas for off road camping with solitude. Road starts off easy, but 4wd / high clearance needed further on & on side roads. Bloody Basin exit off I-17. Archaeological site too that you can walk around.

Name: Hurricane Creek Camp
Description: Trail directly off I40 Westbound in NC. Camp site just about a mile in from interstate. You turn off interstate at the end of guard rail, not an exit. Boondock camping. Large low hanging branches, not ok if you are taller than 8 feet.

Name: Muley Point
Description:
This area is full of great wild camp options but this is one of our favorites even though the secret seems to be out so you will probably not be alone. It can get windy up here but the views are unbeatable. Only amenity here is fire pits. For an unforgettable drive, head north off the 163 through the valley of the gods (road turns off 7.5 miles north of Mexican Hat) on your way here. Roads in are dirt and not suitable for huge rigs.
Four bars on cell service.

Location: Marshall Lake Dispersed Camping, United States
Name: Marshall Lake Dispersed Camping
Description: Open camp sites in the middle of a tall pine forest. About 5 minutes off Lake Mary Road. Huge open areas with lots of places to choose from. Some spots have rock fire pits.

Location: Kaibab Forest Dispersed Camping, United States
Name: Kaibab Forest Dispersed Camping
Description: Free camping at about a dozen sites in a pine forest with fire pits.

Location: Lincoln National Forest Wild Camp, United States
Name: Lincoln National Forest Wild Camp
Description: Lots of pull outs off this forest road to camp. We chose this one with a meadow, fire ring and a pile of wood. Near Rim Trail trail head. Free and very remote.

Name: McDonalds Kanab - NAJA
Description: Shakedown at McDonalds in Kanab for the morning to drive directly to the raffle Wave.

Location: Sand Wash Wild Horse Area, United States
Name: Sand Wash Wild Horse Area
Description: Free camping in the middle of the Sand Wash Wild Horse area. No facilities, BLM land. This spot is next to a small natural pond where lots of wild horses and other animals like pronghorn come to drink.

Location: Rest Stop After Tonopah, NV, United States
Name: Rest Stop After Tonopah, NV
Description: Rest area with basic amenities: restrooms, picnic tables, water, parking area for RVs., low traffic

Location: Rest Stop On Highway 40, United States
Name: Rest Stop On Highway 40
Description: Free parking, big rig friendly. Not very level.

Location: Trinidad Rest Area Southbound, United States
Name: Trinidad Rest Area Southbound
Description:
There is a sign that posts an 8 hour limit. Plenty of car spots and truck spots as well. The rest area has running water, trash cans, picnic tables and flush toilets (heated bathrooms which is a plus). Another nice thing to find out, is that you can use stoves (either at the picnic tables, or outside of your vehicle). They are patrolled by both state troopers and highway patrol and I would think are pretty safe.
Starlink is 200 mbps down. I arrived at 9 pm. A couple of rvs and trucks. TMobile and Verizon are not working. No rv dump.

Name: Flying J
Description: A great last stop in USA before crossing into Mexico. Free to camp , pay showers ( $12) , internet $ 1.99 for an hour.

Location: New Mexico Welcome Center, United States
Name: New Mexico Welcome Center
Description: Free to camp out in their parking lot overnight. Clean bathrooms open all night. Noisy (right by highway) but convenient & free. Water fountain and water bottle filling stations. The welcome center is closed at night.

Location: Boron State Rest Area, Eastbound, United States
Name: Boron State Rest Area, Eastbound
Description:
This is a State Rest Area, so note that there are signs that state maximum 8 hour stay, which is common with all State Rest Areas.

The Rest area has a paved ring road with parking spots under small trees, within short walking distance to picnic tables. As well, a large gravel area circles most of the paved road as well, so many large units can pull over. The west side of the Rest area also has some trees that one can pull their vehicle between to get more shade/ wind cover. Semi trailers have a separate lot to park in.

The washrooms are clean enough for a high traffic Rest area, but staff were there early cleaning up (so use the facilities after they clean). Garbage cans are all over the place, as are the shaded and non-shaded tables. No outside water source found, but there are vending machines on site.

Good place, but It was a little loud. The trucks (of course) run all night and there is a train that passes the Rest area once every hour (at least). There must be an unmarked crossing on the tracks, as the trains blow their horn three or four times each time.

Name: Rufus
Description: North side of I-84 @ Rufus. Was a CoE Park that apparently got turned over to a county that can't afford to maintain it. Pit toilet. No water (other than the river.) Paved to the east, sand to the west. Blackberrys in mid/late summer.

Name: Staybridge Suites
Description: Free! We stayed at Mc Donalds for free Wifi and saw this little Lake behind the Staybridge Suites. Quiet in the Night, no traffic..

Location: New Orleans Parking Lot, United States
Name: New Orleans Parking Lot
Description:
Behind Basin Street Visitor Centre, walking distance to famous French Quarter. The best place to spend a night if you are totally self-contained as there are no RV facilities. Paid parking: $5/10 hours or $10/24 hours for trucks and vans, $50/24 hours for RVs. Quiet during the night, we felt safe the night we stayed there. Right next to us is the French Quarter RV Resort where campers pay close to $100/night!

Bathrooms available when the Visitor Centre is open (8:30-5:30).

Weekend prices are a bit higher I believe.

Paid $20.35 usd for one day of parking. (24 hours)

Location: Premium Parking Lot Nr. 338, United States
Name: Premium Parking Lot Nr. 338
Description: It is very difficult to find a good overnight place in the center of New Orleans. We stayed on a parking lot at the edge of the French Quarter for 6 USD for 10 hours in daytime and 15 USD for 12 hours during evening and the night. There is no security. No facilities but surprisingly quiet during night. The only central campground "French Quarter RV Resort" would have cost around 100 USD/night!!! As of 4/2023, price is about $60 for 24 HR period and less for few hours. It was quiet enough at all times with a little traffic noise. Just make sure you get water elsewhere. There is no place to find a spigot.

Name: Slab City
Description: Love it or hate it! its s great place in the desert to meet others or just get some solitude.

Location: Cherokee Casino Parking Lot, United States
Name: Cherokee Casino Parking Lot
Description: Huge parking lot of the Harrah’s Casino. There were a lot of other RVs. Quiet night. Free. No facilities.

Name: Walmart Parking Lot
Description: Free overnight stay at the walmart parking lot. Walmart 24 hours - 7 days open. Restrooms in the supermarket available, free WiFi at Sam's during their opening hours.

Name: rest area
Description: kids playground, bathrooms, free coffee sometimes and a good place to rest.

Name: Bear Pooh Overlook
Description: Looking for a free spot with a great view? Don't mind a little leveling, or possibly sharing the spot with some fury brown friends? This spot could be for you. Just off Forest Service road, fire pit, and has a GREAT view of the Utah landscape(hoodoos, etc). Not too far from Natural Bridge National Monument and kinda on the way to Canyonlands NP.

Name: Walmart
Description: There’s at least one no overnight parking sign posted.

Location: Hub Of Alaska, Tesoro Gas Station, Glennallen/ Glennallen Visitor Center, Alaska, United States
Name: Hub Of Alaska, Tesoro Gas Station, Glennallen/ Glennallen Visitor Center, Alaska
Description: On the back of the Glennallen Visitor Center/ Tesoro gas station, there is a huge parking lot where you can park and sleep. There are potta potties outside and normal restrooms inside the convenience store of the gas station. There are also 3 canteens that sell hot food. You can easily find the place. Its right at the Glennallen junction (north to Tok/ south to Valdez). Only drawback, you have to pay for wifi at the visitor center (5USD for an hour!!!!!).

Name: Resurrection River Trailhead
Description: Parking spaces with views to Exit Glacier. Near the road but because that road leads only to trek starting point, there is no traffic at all.

Name: Bruegger Centennial Park
Description:
City park campground in Culbertson. allows for 5 days of camping.
Amenities, flush toilet, water, bbq, covered picnictables and even unsecured wifi from one of the neighbouring houses.

Name: Flying J
Description:
Truck stop, large parking lot, clean restrooms.
-Park on the lot by Dennys.

Location: Flying J truck stop, United States
Name: Flying J truck stop
Description: Huge truck stop close to Butte. Free. $10 showers. Free potable water in the red spigot in the rock barriers between the two gas station sections, bring your own hose

Location: Amarillo TX - Texas Travel Information Center, United States
Name: Amarillo TX - Texas Travel Information Center
Description: Address: Amarillo Travel Information Center, 9700 I-40, Amarillo, TX 79118 A big parking lot with restrooms (24 hours) and free wifi. In Texas there are 12 travel information centers where you are allowed to stay for free overnight (Amarillo, Anthony, austin, denison, gainesville, langtry, laredo, orange, texarkana, valley, waskom, wichita falls).

Name: SanLuisCamp
Description: Behind the church in the parking spaces. Quiet, dark, nice.

Name: Utah Welcome Center
Description: Rest Area on 70W before Thompson Springs. Very peaceful night. Several trucks and overnighters here as well. Clean bathrooms. Water spigot appears to be OFF.

Name: Spotlight 29 Casino
Description: A large open lot for RV and big rig parking. Very noisy and freeway noise.

Location: Blue Ridge Wildlife Management Area, United States
Name: Blue Ridge Wildlife Management Area
Description: Beautiful River front camping in this WMA, a few nice sites right by the river. No ATT service, got Vzw with the booster. Continue up the road for more/better sites.

Location: Sinclair Gas Station/Truck Stop, United States
Name: Sinclair Gas Station/Truck Stop
Description: The Sinclair has a side parking lot for semi trucks so we asked the cashier inside if we could pay to park overnight. He said we could and didn't need to pay. I told him we'd get our gas here in the morning and buy some snacks. Not that there are signs in some areas stating No Parking. The semi area is labeled with a TRUCKS only sign in the North fence, that is where we parked. The restaurant two doors down let us use the restroom. Couldn't hear the traffic on the road next to the gas station. The semi trucks were on all night but it didn't bother is. It's not a quiet spot but was darker than a Walmart parking lot!

Name: Little A'Le'Inn
Description: Restaurant in Rachel, NV near Area 51 that plays on alien theme. They have for spots with water and electric hookups plus tent camping and dry camping area. Tent and dry camping are free. 4 bars with Verizon.

Name: Hall's Crossing Chevron
Description: Gas station and small general store. Campground nearby. Pumps operate even if store is closed with a credit card. Expensive. but not many other fuel options this side of the river for a long ways.

Name: Outside Diamond Lake
Description: North of Crater Lake NP, this is closest gas station. It’s at the corner across from Pony/ horse rides. About 1.5 miles north of Diamond Lake reaper south entrance

Location: Hilltop Cafe & Truck Stop, United States
Name: Hilltop Cafe & Truck Stop
Description: Elliot Highway. A must-stop truck stop cafe with good food and a shower. If you are headed north up the Dalton Highway, this is your last stop before the Yukon River. There are only very basic groceries here, not a place to stock up for a week.

Name: Keystone
Description: Gas station. 3 gas pumps and 2 bay garage. Small selection of tires

Name: Keystone
Description: Gas station. Two pumps. Larger convenience store. Subway restaurant within building.

Name: Citgo
Description: Gas station with medium sized convenience store. Has basic food/water necessities

Name: Denio Junction
Description: Diesel & gasoline 24 hr credit card pump. Denio Junction was without fuel for many years, but has it now (December 2018)

Name: Sinclair Gas
Description: There are only two gas stations in the area. This one and a Silver Eagle

Name: Open Door Store/Gas
Description: Small store and gas pump in Lowman. Reasonably priced gas, basic gas station necessities and food. You fill up at the pump then pay inside based on how much you fill up. Staff is very helpful and we let them know about this site/app, so if you happen to lose service or someone needs guidance they can help and add great things for this area too! This place helped extend our adventure instead of heading all the way to a further town just to get gas!

Name: Maybell General Store
Description:
This is a small gas station, has gas, diesel, propane, free air for tires (saved me I cut a tire and was able to plug it in dinosaur and didn't have my air compressor) this is the first place east of the monument with anything. The store has a little bit of everything food, camping gear, automotive supplies.

Last available gas for many miles if you're heading north on Hwy 318.

Name: Northern Oilfield Services
Description:
This location is open to tourists. We were directed here by the other gas station on the east side of town. When we arrived, other tourists were also filling here as well as workers.

Credit card only.

The machine didn't read my first card, but read my second card. Another tourist I was here with had the machine read her card on the first try. Just beware.

The pumps are in the shack, the prices are on the pumps and not posted outside. Just look through the windows.

On August 6, regular was $7.99 and diesel was $7.29.

If you want a receipt, you pump your gas and then return to the credit card machine and enter your card again and follow the on screen prompts and it will print a receipt.

Location: Yukon River gas station, United States
Name: Yukon River gas station
Description: Same price as Coldfoot, suggest filling up as much as possible at the truck station that's already on ioverlander south of here, Hilltop cafe and truck stop.

Location: Tangle River inn / Gas - Shower - Restaurant, United States
Name: Tangle River inn / Gas - Shower - Restaurant
Description: Restaurant/gas/tire repair. Gas is $6.50/gallon. But it’s there if you need it. Nothing in Paxson.

Name: Chevon - Vacuum
Description: Free vacuum next to the car wash. There’s a sign saying ‘please do not abuse’, really good action from the vacuum!

Name: Fuel & Free Vacuums
Description: Gas station with cheap fuel where you can use free vacuums to clean your car on the spot, just great! You can’t use the vacuums from 8 p.m. because of the sound for the neighbourhood.

Location: Exit for London Bridge, United States
Name: Exit for London Bridge
Description:
I’ll delete if wrong but it looks like this is the last cheap place for gas before you hit freaking California state gas taxes (as of today’s date was $2.50/gallon in Kingman and $2.75 here.... but I know will be closer to $4 back in my beloved Cali)
Fil ‘er up!
Few eateries here too.

Name: Redwood Casino Gas
Description: The reservation gas station, so it’s much cheaper than anywhere in the area.

Name: Yosemite Valley
Description: No gas in the valley. This is your last chance to fill up. No overnight parking.

Name: Pit Stop
Description: Also can get water, dump and propane. This place is very busy in the winter, especially January, but is good at getting rigs in and out. 928-927-3714; 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM; 7 days a week; 425 N. Central / US95, Quartzsite, AZ 85346

Name: Crane Store & Cafe
Description: Gas and diesel available at this little store, along with basic food stuffs, cafe, and RV hook-ups.

Name: Frenchlen Mercantile
Description: Nice little shop with 87 octane and diesel

Name: Emigrant General Store
Description: This gas station is packed with useful stuff. Large fresh produce section with fruit and vegetables, camping gear, and lots of drinks and take home ice cream. There is a laundromat on site. You can also use the self-service car wash to knock the dust off your rig.

Location: Only gas for 150 miles, United States
Name: Only gas for 150 miles
Description: Yep, started freaking out that we wouldn’t have enough fuel until Glennallen (next town 70 miles up) and nothing on here or Google displayed a nearby station. This is a small little place but they have gas if you’re in a pinch!

Name: Fields Station
Description: Gas but you will pay premium prices due to it's location

Name: Chevron
Description: Gas Station with food. No propane fill. Has large diesel fill up area. There's also a large gravel area. You could probably spend a night here as well. I see a semi in there. Most likely sleeping.

Name: ARCO GASOLINE
Description: $2.51 at this time of reporting. Cheapest gas in Beatty. Hand window washing fluid to scrub bugs off. Has bathrooms. Clean.

Location: Phillips 66 & Roadrunner Travel Center, United States
Name: Phillips 66 & Roadrunner Travel Center
Description:
This is a gas station with plenty of spots around for trucks and travelers that need to spend the night. The convenience store is open 24 hrs.
It's not the quietest spot but it's a spot for the night.
Right off the Hwy 25.

Name: Alltown Fresh
Description: They have DEF (diesel additive) at the pump, great, healthy foods and snacks and a free dump station!

Name: Sinclair fuel
Description: Fuel stop. All paved, seems nice and clean. Plenty of room to turn around. Napa auto care center and grocery open in the warm season?

Location: Oasis Stop n’ Go, United States
Name: Oasis Stop n’ Go
Description: Regular and Diesel available, cheap. Decent offerings at the little shop.

Name: Jo-Bi Convenience Market
Description:
This place also has potable water if you asks for “the key” to turn the spigot.

Fill during open hours only:
Mo-Fr: 5am-10pm
Sa: 6am-10pm
Su: 7am-8pm

Name: Cap'n Joe's Gas
Description: Water for $5 on the back of the Tesoro gas station - at the propane tank you will find the tap. You will also find a laundry at this gas station. There is also a dumping just 30 ft away at the RV campground for $10. Car wash too.

Name: Truck Service
Description: There are water spigots over by the truck fuel island. Each pump has a water spigot.

Name: Maverick Gas Station
Description: Potable water on the left side of the building near pump 11. This is a FREE dump station at the Maverick Gas Station. Open 24h for water potable and dump station. Gas cheap.

Name: water spring
Description: Water spring on side of road with free water.

Name: Meskwaki
Description: Water tap at casino RV Park behind casino, way in the back. The RV park is closed, so no hook ups, but the water is accessible. Staff said I could stay the night in the parking lot. Great place

Location: Joshua Tree NP Visitors Centre, United States

Description: Free potable water for motorhomes from tap in carpark

Name: Glacier Water Dispenser
Description: Do-it-yourself water dispenser across the street from the Eastside Branch Public Library. 35 cents a gallon or $1.75 for 5 gallons.

Name: 7 - Eleven
Description: Water $.25 per 5 gallons - pay inside and they will give you the key. (Price may vary)

Name: Gearheads
Description: Outdoor gear store offering free filtered water inside the store. Bring and fill your own container. A cart is provided so you can wheel your jugs back to your vehicle.

Name: Rest area
Description:
Several spigots, but they are all turned off.

Update June 2022: Water available. (Probably seasonal.)

Name: Anchor Point
Description: Public water supply. 25 cents for 6 gallons. Pumps for large and small tanks. Price is 3.67 gallons for $0.25. Good for filling containers , there is no thread on the smaller hose, and a water witch does not work with it.

Name: Dolores park
Description: There is a water spigot on the left as you enter the park. Good pressure, but you need a 50 foot hose!

Name: Smiths Fuel Center
Description:
This locaton is now closed.
Recommended by Hyde Memorial State Park as place to get water since theirs is limited. There is a lock but the attendant happily opened it and said they are one of only places around.

Name: Pilar
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Seasonal closures reported.

Free Water for drinking. Visitor center Rio Grande!

Water is beside unattached restrooms/outhouses.

Name: South Kaibab Trailhead
Description:
Water refill station at the South Kaibab Trailhead (also a shuttle bus station for the Grand Canyon orange line)

Potable spring water for filling bottles or jugs. Not suitable to fill RVs. Within a chainlink fence that keeps wildlife out.

Name: Haines Gas Station.
Description: Gas station with free RV service. Potable water available. Free air as well but no gauge.

Name: Chevron
Description: FREE potable water on South side of building. Red spigot by the air station. See other check-ins for further info! Enjoy!

Name: Edward's Rest Area
Description: Beautiful Riverwalk next to the rest area. Potable water fill. Free. Available April through November.

Name: Water
Description: Portable Water Fountain for Bottles in the National Forest Area. Tastes fine with our Filter. Low pressure.

Location: Boettcher Park Picnic Area, United States
Name: Boettcher Park Picnic Area
Description: Picnic area with restrooms, trash, recycling, water spout, tables and swings.

Name: Next to Allsup's
Description:
Free potable water on the corner. Very easy access for rigs. We filled up our two 6 gallon jugs.

Spigot off and employees are unable to unlock for you

Location: Moab - Lions Park Spigot, United States
Name: Moab - Lions Park Spigot
Description: Two threaded spigots in the lower lot- there is also a filtered bottle fill station in the pavilion up the stairs. There are electric outlets in the pavilion Carrie the grass if you need to charger computer/jackery and tables to sit down on in the shade

Location: Mtn Village Service Station, United States
Name: Mtn Village Service Station
Description: RV Propane, free potable water. Gas/diesel is ghastly expensive tourist pricing, avoid the gas. ($1 additional per gallon) Free water behind the gas station. Good hoses. long enough to fill RV. Further, I would bring some type of filter too. I’m sure it’s perfectly fine, and it’s 100% potable, but who knows what is creeping and crawling up that hose.

Name: Next to McDonalds
Description: Go in the back and open a small metal door. Written water on it.

Name: Olsens IGA store
Description: water here as well as a couple of other places. All the same price - buck for 5 gallons. Biggest store in Ajo. deli has WiFi.

Name: Arjencía Water
Description: Water kiosk on E Fort Lowell Rd. near N Mountain Ave. 15¢ a gallon.

Name: king sooper
Description: water refill 39 cents a gallon, inside @ entrance

Name: Speedway
Description: Next to propane bottles outside there is a water tap you can use. On the other side of the building there is free air (instead of the paid air pump).

Name: T.L.C. Auto Repair
Description: Excellent Toyota mechanic at TLC Auto, Fred took great care of us even finding ways to save us money. They charged $50/hr labour. www.tlc-auto.com 858 541 0852.

Location: Automotive Super Center Longview Texas, United States
Name: Automotive Super Center Longview Texas
Description: 1109 W loop 281 Longview Texas these guys are great friendly and solved my diesel problem in a morning and fixed it I came off the street and they stated on it immediately great price great service great coffee thanks Doug Thanks Chris

Name: Westlake Automotive
Description: Straight forward shop that can work on diesel 4x4's

Description:
If anyone needs a Land Rover mechanic near San Diego, we can highly recommend this garage! Peter is very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. :)

https://www.facebook.com/BritishAutoworksSanDiego/?fref=ts

Name: Werkstatt
Description: Werkstatt San Antonio

Description: There are only a few really good Land Rover mechanics in the states, Bill Davis in Salt Lake City is one of them. He works with Land Rovers since decades and knows everything about Series and Defenders. We stopped here for doing some maintenance and getting some spare parts. We camped behind the workshop before hitting the road again the next day.

Name: West Coast British (LR)

Land Rover specialist near San Francisco. Mike runs this workshop since 1981 and knows everything about Land Rovers.

190 Airway Blvd.
Livermore, CA 94551

925-606-8301

it is on the corner of East Sahara Avenue and South Mojave Road in Las Vegas

Description: My van needed a little fixing as I came into town and I was directed to this place. The owner Lance is super knowledgeable, helpful, friendly, and just an all round great guy. I would highly recommend visiting if you have anything that needs work. I would definitely come back here again. I wish these guys were my local mechanics.

Name: Terry Lee Enterprises

terryleeenterprises.com
708 E 1st St
LA Junta, Co 81050

719-384-0882

Name: Green Machine
Description: A great garage with mexicans guys. We have changed the oil and filter of our Defender Land Rover. The price is good. Muy buena gente!!!

Location: Bonita Valley Auto Care, United States

We arrived on time, the guy went to see the van, came back and suddenly a worker was missing and he was not able to take care if our van. There were hours of delay and he insisted that we go to another place and even called one for us. Impression was he did not want to take care if our van but he did not tell it the dat before when we took the apointment.

Name: Valley Hybrids
Description: Georg and his team really know what they're doing. Specialists in Toyota Land Cruiser (no other makes or models!) they will solve your issues fast and efficient. Highly recommended.

Location: Fox's Friendly Automotive LLC, United States
Name: Fox's Friendly Automotive LLC
Description: Very good mechanic

Name: O'Reilly Auto Parts

Name: Westy werks
Description: Specialist european vehicles esp. vw. These guys have taken over all the work that Gowesty used to do and thank goodness for that! 20 minutes from Gowesty they can get all the parts you need and they are super helpfull and offer good impartial advice.

Name: Duo tech
Description: it is a good place to repair the car. they work well with travelers.

Name: World Auto Body
Description: Very friendly and helpful mechanic that helped us with some welding, even though we arrived afer 5pm on a friday night. Specialised in auto repair and collision repair. We highly recommend Juan and his team.

Name: Precision Performance
Description: Perfect mechanic in Las Vegas. Specially Toyota and Lexus.

Name: The Bike revolution
Description:
This shop is bike, rental and fix.
a lot of bike gear.
experenced bke mechanick.

Name: Dixie 4 Wheel Drive

They are really friendly and helpful. If you have your European filters - they maintain all 4 wheel vehicles.
We were really satisfied!

Name: Brookings en Oregon
Description: Garage spécialisé en transmission. Patron sympa. Prix corrects. Dormi sur place avec eau électricité et w.c.

Name: motohank motorcycle workshop

Hank is an old traveller and has been working on BMW's for many years. He is a one of a kind mechanic and knows his stuff
He also sells tires and Touratech goodies. Can help with other brands.

Name: Navarro mechanic
Description: Pedro the owner helped us replacing the water pump. Decent guy. He let us stay at his entrance and gave electricity. Higly recommended.

fast and helpful mechanic.
reasonable price (100$ per hour of work).

Next to a fuel station, Aldi supermarket across the road, and another shopping plaza with Planet Fitness gym across the other street. There is also a power outlet inside.

Take a $7 hot shower whilst you wait on the laundry, perfect combination!

Prices are dependent on cycle selections. Hot water extra, heavy soiled extra…

Name: Torrey
Description:
Laundry is 2.00 wash and 2.00 dry.
Store staff are nice and the place is very well maintained and clea.

Name: Back Bay Laundromat
Description: Great value for your money, machines clean but not the newest. Baywood is a cute small town with awesome bay views.

Very nice and clean laundromat.
wash: 2,25usd
dryer:1,75usd

Name: Soft Suds Laundry
Description: big laundry, $7 wash and dry a big machine, nice people

Name: Coin laundry
Description: washers and dryers. next to a convience store that has laundry soap.

Name: We‘ll wash Laundry
Description: Self-Service Laundry. You can also let wash your clothes.

Location: One stop coin laundry, United States
Name: One stop coin laundry
Description: Clean laundry. Personnel sympathique. Easy parking

Description: Amazing place, particularly in the off-season when facilities in Bryce are closed. $5 showers (unlimited time), wash $2.25, dry $1.50, free WiFi. Also groceries available in the shop and a warm place to sit!

Name: Lavanderia
Description: $4.75 for a triple load. Drying is free! Busy on this Sunday afternoon. Fluff and fold service.

Name: 123 Wash & Dry
Description: Dry Cleaning times 8-6 (Mon-Fri) and 9-5 (Sat), self-service open until 11pm, last washing time 10.30. The usual: Good industrial machines, 3 different sizes, decent prices, fairly clean. We recommend this place!

Buena Vista is a nice little town near many outdoor activities.

DAY USE ONLY.

5:00am to 10:00pm Mon. - Thurs.
5:00am to 9:00pm Friday 6 00am to 8:00pm Saturday

Description:
*Closed during periods of water shortage.

Has drinking water, dump station, showers (2.50$ for 5min.), laundry. Wifi, but ATM is not working.

Showers are controlled by quarter machines. There's a coin machine inside. 10 quarters per session. Do not turn off the shower to soap up or the machine will end your shower session.

Name: Bozeman Swim Center
Description:
$2 for a shower.
Currently open Monday to Friday.
5:30-7a and noon-1p, also some evening hours from 4:35-8:40 pm.
Closed weekends.

20 min limit, but not enforced. Communal showers and change room. Water is warm to cool.

Location: Hot Token Showers in Bryce, United States

Description:
Moderator Note: Seasonal Closures.

8 minute, hot, clean showers for $3 on the side of the general store inside a (heated bathroom). Really chill early & late day, open 8am to 8pm, laundry available as well. Tourists around and parking is tough mid-day. These require entry to the park. Nice sunrise / amphitheater view nearby!

Name: Showers Florence Laundry
Description:
Showers in the laundry (near the thrift store, on 37th street), 4 dollars for 8 minutes, great !!! And you can wash your clothings in the same time !

Showers looked clean although I did not take one. I thought the laundry was reasonable anywhere from $3.75 to 6 $ depending on the machine that you use. They also have wifi!

Name: Seward
Description: Hot showers for only $2 for 7 minutes. There is a token machine outside that will accept $1 or $5 bills only (no change given). Water is HOT with great water pressure. Fairly clean.

Name: Skagway Harbour Master
Description: Clean public showers at the boat harbor in Skagway. 25 cents for 1.5 minutes. Open 24/7. Very good. Also 2 more showers at the rear.

Name: Salmon Harbor Marina
Description:
Public Showers and Restrooms. Showers $1 for first four minutes then .25 for each additional minute. Open to the public, you do not have to be staying at the campground. Showers open 0815- 1530.
There are dish washing sinks on the back outside wall of each restroom. Only the furthest one has showers. There are also trash and recycling bins in the marina.

Name: Sisters
Description:
Clean and hot showers in Sisters.
1$ in Quarters per 2 minutes. (both showers)

Showers 7AM-6PM. Takes quarters. No change machine. Bathrooms also present.

Laundry, showers and water fill up.
