Laundry (for a medium size washer) $5.50 USD
Open 7am -8:30pm daily.

Location: Hot Springs State Park Bath House, United States
Name: Hot Springs State Park Bath House
Description: Free bathhouse with showers. You can use it for 20 minutes. open daily. communal showers. the website says the park has an entry fee but there's nowhere to pay, just lots of donation points.

Location: Vitus/Trapper Creek Trading Post, United States
Name: Vitus/Trapper Creek Trading Post
Description:
Public showers. Nice, heated, spotless private bathrooms, 4 USD/10min running hot water. Quarters only (they will make change for you).
Also, gas here is cheaper than in Cantwell.

Location: Naabia Niign / Northway Jct, United States
Name: Naabia Niign / Northway Jct
Description: 3 USD showers @ Naabia Niign / Northway Jct . Depending on which shower you get, you might not even have a time limit. This might be your cheapest shower in Alaska. Hot, clean showers 3 USD (for 15 mins).

Location: Public Bath Sunset Empire Seaside, United States
Name: Public Bath Sunset Empire Seaside
Description: Public Bath with Gym and Hot Tub. Day fee is 9,- for non residents, you can uns the facilities the whole day. They offer shower for 2,- but only Mon-Fri 5:45-8am and 6-7pm, Sat 3-5pm, Sun 12-2pm (extra 1$ for towel)

Name: Boathouse
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: This Place has conflicting reports about whether it is open or closed.

Good hot showers at boathouse. Get tokens at office boathouse upstairs. GO TO NEW HARBOR!

12 minutes costs $4 dollar. @ boathouse

Location: Swift Current Motor Inn, United States
Name: Swift Current Motor Inn
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Seasonal closures reported.

Showers available for $4+tax for an 8 min shower. Pay inside the Swiftcurrent Motor Inn Gift Shop.
The shop closes at 9 pm, so buy tokens beforehand if you want to take a shower later.

There's also self-serve soft-serve Blackberry ice cream for $3.50. Probably the best deal in the park as it's a big cup and you can really pile it in there!

Name: Sturgis Community Center
Description: Swimming pool, showers, hot tub, sauna. $5; $4 for seniors. phone: 605-347-6513 https://sturgisareachamber.com/membership/profile/sturgis-community-center

Name: Signal Mountain Campground
Description: $5 public showers for 7 mins. Hot and cold water. Tokens only. Tokens can be changed for cash or credit in laundry next door.

Name: Canyon Street Laundromat
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Seasonal closures reported.

Laundromat, showers, water. parking nearby, wifi from Weston next to it and plug-ins for charging stuff like macbooks, phone etc.

Name: Leadbetter Beach
Description: For free... Here you can shower (free) and take the toilettes. Easy. After you pay $3.50 dollars to park for 1 hour or $22/per day. Not private.

Name: Lake Padden Park
Description: Nice park with picnic tables and a lake. Inside the bathroom house there are free warm showers. Main bathrooms and showers are separated but shower room does have the toilet stall and urinary on the men's side. Community shower heads like the one in college/high school.

Name: YMCA Community Centre
Description:
Place where you can get a shower. (This was not the case when I visited on 11/15/23. ) Just ask, subscribe and go!
Subsequent visits require a $ 15 day pass

Name: Armijo Pool
Description: Public aquatics center with warm showers. $3 USD

Location: Hot showers at YMCA Ocean Springs, United States
Name: Hot showers at YMCA Ocean Springs
Description:
The friendly folks at this YMCA let me take a great hot shower. It's free if it's your first visit to this YMCA. If it isn't it's 8 USD.
Nice pool, too.
Free wifi available.

Name: Tacoma Center YMCA
Description:
Place to take free hot showers, you only need an official id. “Monday-Friday: 10-11am, 8-9pm. Saturday: 10-11am, 6-7pm. Sunday: 10-11am.”
Not the cleanest but nice showers.

https://www.ymcapkc.org/tacoma-center-ymca/programs/community-showers/

Name: Willow Draw Campground
Description: This park is super cool to visit and is only $4 per person. This also includes access to their showers and bathrooms for free!

Location: U-haul, Las Cruces NM, United States
Name: U-haul, Las Cruces NM
Description: Have propane refill facility but the system was broken… no service.

Name: Neales Propane
Description: You must be able to remove your tanks at this place. They sell it based on weight!

Location: High Country Gas And Supply Inc, United States
Name: High Country Gas And Supply Inc
Description: Grand Junction, Colorado: refilled our 3 kg French "camping gaz" bottle. Also welding supplier so will be able to build a propane connection if necessary. Address: 1039 Pitkin avenue

Location: Capps Home Building Center, United States
Name: Capps Home Building Center
Description: Nice hardware, lumber yard that sell propane

Name: Barnett's Propane
Description: Easy access from I-10. Cheap.

Name: Shell gas station
Description:
Crazy gas prices but convenient propane fill up for RV's

Also a west indian food place inside the gas station.

Name: Speedway
Description: Propane fill behind the station. Prepay inside. Currently $3.30 per gallon

Name: Action Shop Services
Description: Propane refill for RV. Great staff and service. $2,60 per gallon.

Name: Superstition FEEDPET
Description:
Behind Wells Fargo Bank, 666 N Idaho Rd, Apache Junction, AZ 85119
1.99$ gal. Easy to access.

place Deleted - fill commercial only

Name: Cortez Gaz Company
Description: 413 East Third, Truth or Consequences NM

Name: Arco Propane
Description:
Easy in/out
free Fresh water to, near to propane.

Name: Love's Travel Shop
Description:
Place to fill any kind of propane tank.
3.49 USD/Gal

Name: Haines Garage
Description: Refill of propane tanks : 9$ + tx for 20 lbs or 4,50$ + tx for 10 lbs. Can fill RV tank too

Location: Holbrook (also refill ARG bottle), United States
Name: Holbrook (also refill ARG bottle)
Description: We refill our argentinian bottle. Laundry. Diesel.

Name: Gas station 76
Description: Cheap diesel and propane available. Ideal before crossing the border to Baja California.

Name: u-haul
Description: ouvert 7 jours sur 7. Paiement à la pompe.

Name: Propane supply
Description: This place was described in the iOverlander entry "Enchanted trails RV park and trading post".

Name: Tractor Supply
Description: Very friendly place to get your rv propane tank filled! They even fill VW Westfalia's tank

Location: Farm & City Feed and RV Supply, United States
Name: Farm & City Feed and RV Supply
Description: Standard propane rates apply. $4.49/gallon Very friendly service. We filled a standard household USA BBQ bottle or built in propane attachments too. . Out tank was 7.5 gallons and there was another guy there filling up standard 5 gallon bottles. or the big built in bottles. $5 holding tank fee, but free water fill ups. nice people... support the locals

Location: Bicknell Howies gas station, United States
Name: Bicknell Howies gas station
Description:
Closest place from capitol reef NP
For Propane tank refill
Big Rig access

Location: Butte General Store & Marine / Gas Station, United States
Name: Butte General Store & Marine / Gas Station
Description:
We refilled our propane tank at USD 2.90 per gallon (Nov 26, 2017). This gas station is open on Sundays and will fill-up your motorhome's propane tank.

Our tank has an ACME valve connector (or also called QCC [Quick Closing Coupling] or OPD [Overfill Protection Device]). But I'm quite confident that they would be able to handle other valve connectors, such as POL (Prest-O-Lite).

Name: Suburban propane
Description:
Due to covid policy changes this location no longer provides propane to the walk in public. Propane only provided to account holders.

Awesome stop. Very glad with the service. Knowledgeable. I think they can handle quite a few different types of connections since all they did was handle propane.

Name: U-Haul Supply
Description: Open 7 days a week from 7 am to 7pm. Drive to the propane tank and ring the bell.

Location: Chevron - 2232 Biddle Rd, Medford, OR, United States
Name: Chevron - 2232 Biddle Rd, Medford, OR
Description: Propane refill came as a recommendation from a RV dealership. The awesome staff totally knew how to fill up our Eurovan camper.

Location: Fas Fuel Oracle and Prince Tucson., United States
Name: Fas Fuel Oracle and Prince Tucson.
Description: Gas station at the Northwest corner of Prince and N Oracle. Propane is advertised as $1.89 per gallon, but this price is only if you get 10 gallons or more. Less than 10 gallons is $2.39 per gallon. Visited on 2/3/18.

Name: Big Bend Station/Alon
Description:
Gas station and propane around back. Propane refills are only available between 1PM-3PM.

Available connections not known, but a VW vanagon with a 3 gallon propane tank was filled it with no problem. (tank is close to the horse stables).

Name: Chevron
Description: Propane fill station. Nice people, convenient location.

Name: Cajun Propane
Description: Place to fill propane! 17$ for 20 pounds bottle

Name: Marina boat & RV
Description: We managed to fill our Argentinean bottle without issues.

Name: Hero Market
Description: Propane Service, Fuel Gas Diesel, Food, Water,Store

Name: Welcome Center
Description:
Dump station with water for rinsing.
First visit the welcome center for your maps, nice clean, restrooms, etc. Then fill your potable water on the right side when pulling out of the truck RV parking.
Lastly, before going onto the exit to the highway, there is a dump station with water for rinsing your tanks


Right location, but if you want to visit the welcome center (must see!!!) do it first since the dump station is just before exit. No potable water, but there's a hose to rinse.

Location: Sinclair ProStop Gas Station, United States
Name: Sinclair ProStop Gas Station
Description: RV waste dump ($6), and regularity and premium gas. Diesel as well. Mini Mart with Food and supplies

Name: Delta Petro Wash
Description: Fuel station with dump, water, laundry. Gas pumps include high flow for HDTs or other large diesels. Dump and potable water are in easy to get to station. They are free to use. There is a large car wash that will accept big rigs. Laundry has 4 washers and 4 dryers. Uses cards or coins. Propane fill up also on site.

Name: Dumpstation Homer
Description: Dump station $15 with potable water, picnic table and poop bags for dogs

Name: Speedway Express
Description: Gratis Entleerungsstation hinter der Tankstelle. Inkl. Wasser und Schlauch. Hat auch Abfall-Container nebenan.

Location: 5 Mile Campground Dump Station, United States
Name: 5 Mile Campground Dump Station
Description: Dump Station, still currently free. Do not use the drinking water station to clean out your tanks.

Location: Upper Blue Sanitation District, United States
Name: Upper Blue Sanitation District
Description:
RVs welcome. Dirt pad across from the plant (there was zero odor). Sits just east of the river with plenty of space for multiple vehicles, including a big rig or two. Fees for sanitation dump.

During the winter the potable water spigot is turned off, you have to hookup to a spigot on the side of the building next to the payment slot.

Open year-round

Location: Lee Vining Gas Station, United States
Name: Lee Vining Gas Station
Description: Gas station, the most expensive prices in the country. But they have a sewer dump station. N. 34.947116 W 119.113206

Name: Goblin Valley
Description: Dumping Station with water read check it’s for prices.

Name: Colorado Welcome Centre
Description: Free dump station and toilets & showers across the street from Colorado Welcome Center. There is no pressure tap water.

Location: Harris Beach campground and rest area, United States
Name: Harris Beach campground and rest area
Description: Only Day Use. Permit/fee area now. Not a rest area.

Name: Chevron Dump Station
Description: Is now 10$, open 24/7, non potable water available, free if you refill gasoline

Location: Welcome Center Colorado, Fruita, United States
Name: Welcome Center Colorado, Fruita
Description:
Exactly as described. Dump station with 2 bays and 4 spigot 2 of potable, 2 for cleaning. (Positioned a little too close together, tho.)

One potable spigot was not usable as threads had been stripped.

Some visitor left an unsanitary mess in the dump bay.

Very generous of Colorado to sponsor this service for travelers.

Name: Lees Ferry
Description:
Potable Water & Dump free even it says "for campground users only".
Seasonal closures.

Name: Veterans Memorial Park
Description: Next to the campground, at the public restrooms, you can find a dump station and potable water.

Name: Mississippi Welcome Center
Description: Dump station located in rear. Also had designated pet area for walking. Potable water available.

Location: State Trailer RV & Outdoor Supply, United States
Name: State Trailer RV & Outdoor Supply
Description:
FREE dump in the back Mon-Sat 9-5:15
Propane $3.19/gallon Mon-Sat 9-5:15

RV superstore
No overnight stays

Closed Sundays

Name: Texaco Hurricane
Description: Texaco gas station has dump facilities, with potable water. Looks to be free. Large space, suitable for big rigs. It’s next to the air pump.

Location: Hood River Dump Station, United States
Name: Hood River Dump Station
Description:
Dump Station and potable water $10,- dump & fill fee.
Non-Potable water at the dump station, and potable water at a tap forward of the dump station.

Location: Humbug Mountain State Park (Dump Station), United States
Name: Humbug Mountain State Park (Dump Station)
Description:
Dump Station and potable water. free.

It's also a campground next to it:
-22$ with electricity
-17$ without electricity
-2$ only shower

If you like hiking, next to it is the Humbug Mountain Trail. Very nice forest and nice view. 5km, 600m height difference.

Name: Blanding RV Park
Description: Pay at 7-11 located at the Exxon station next door $10 to dump, $5 per 50 gallons of water.

Name: Maverick Fuel
Description: Clean and easy for a free dump and potable water (at pump 22); non-potable water at dump station. Located on south side of the gas station.

Location: Old Isabella Rd. Recreation Site, United States
Name: Old Isabella Rd. Recreation Site
Description: $20 sani dump located just outside the day use fee area. Accepts credit cards only. This is part of the SaniStarDump.com network. We didn't use it, but marking it here for others since it wasn't listed for some reason.

Location: No Man's Land Regional Park, United States
Name: No Man's Land Regional Park
Description:
Free dump station with potable water located in a county park.

Lift the metal lid. The yellow non-potable spigot is connected to the dump well and rinses it. There is no water to rinse your tank hoses. To the left of the dump is a blue spigot, (assuming potable) with very strong pressure.

Location: NP Dump and Water free, United States
Name: NP Dump and Water free
Description: Dump and Water for free next to the campground

Location: Salt Wells (Close to Fallon / Sand Mountains), United States
Name: Salt Wells (Close to Fallon / Sand Mountains)
Description: Dumping station in the middle of the desert $15. The non-potable was out of order.

Name: Roseville Automall Chevron
Description: Water & dump, Is now $10.00 flat fee with or without fueling and fuel is more expensive than other stations.

Name: Colter Bay Campground
Description:
RV dump available for non-guests for $10, have to pay in the office first.

At the General Store (500m away from campground) there are also showers, laundry and free WiFi. Electricity at laundry and drinking water tap outside to fill water containers. $38 per night.

Name: Rest Area
Description:
This is a rest area with bathrooms and a dump station. Also potable water to fill your tank up!
Water fountains and fill-up spout are taped off! Nov 2020

Location: Death Valley Visitor Centre, United States
Name: Death Valley Visitor Centre
Description: Dump station and free potable water to fill in front of the Death Valley visitor center.

Location: Hi Country Market & Hardware, United States
Name: Hi Country Market & Hardware
Description:
This little market has groceries, prepared food, and even a well provisioned hardware section with fuses and basic RV and automotive parts.

This location is also a Chevron gas station and the owners run the attached bristecone motel and adjacent laundromat.

Name: Lincoln Hardware
Description:
Very complete hardware store!
We needed to do some work in our van and we found everything here.

Location: Blue Ridge Overland Gear, United States
Name: Blue Ridge Overland Gear
Description:
The Blue Ridge Overland Gear production facility and shop in Bedford, Virginia. Meet the BROG team, do a quick tour and check out our gear in real-time and see where all the action happens! We're in a brown metal building. When you get to the loop at the end of the driveway, just turn right and you'll see us. Parking is in front and in back of the brown metal building.

Store Hours: Monday to Friday (9 am - 5 pm)

www.BlueRidgeOverlandGear.com

We have free camping on-site and off-site overflow camping on Private Land available for anyone that has stopped into our store and received verbal permission to camp. If after store hours and you cannot get a hold of anyone here, Peaks of Otter Campground is 9miles to the NW of Bedford, VA just off of the Blue Ridge Parkway and costs $20/night.

While you're in town check out all that Bedford and the surrounding area has to offer - including restaurants, wineries, breweries, hiking, camping, and outdoor adventuring of all kinds. Setup base camp at the Peaks of Otter, do some day hiking on the Appalachian Trial or other local hikes, go deep into the Washington and Jefferson National Forests, and go exploring along the breathtaking Blue Ridge Parkway.

Name: Market Basket
Description: One of the best Grocery store chains in New England. Good food resupply if you are in the area. Cheap too.

Name: Marathon French Supermarket
Description: Small with fast WiFi + unusual foreign products too.

Name: Walasi-Yi
Description:
This is a store and rest location on the Appalachian Trail near where it crosses US29 at Neels Gap. It is at the approach of Blood Mountain. It will be the closest store in a wilderness area that has many unimproved campsites. Cellphone services is typically available due to the elevation.

The store has camping and hiking equipment, outdoor clothing, books, maps, snacks, prepared frozen foods, and other supplies.

Name: Walmart Milwaukee
Description:
Walmart parking lot.
Ask to the customer service to check in.
To be sure to don’t have trouble, park on the left side of the parking lot (when you are facing the Walmart) with the trucks.
The Walmart is open 24/24 so you can have access to the restroom.

Name: Grocery, Whittier, Alaska
Description: Medium size grocery, all the usual stuff for a small town. The building also houses the museum which is excellent ($5). There is also a hardware store near the ferry terminal, a hotel, and another grocery reported to be in the big high rise building (I didn’t check it out).

Name: Bellville Meat Market
Description:
Seriously the best Texas meat you can get. The place is an institution. Make the detour if cruising along I-10 for some local country hospitality and great food. Known widely for their Summer Sausage, but I can't get enough of the beef jerky. Also have hot briskett rolls and others available for lunch

Note: We do have a family connection here but you don't just get announced as one of H.E.B.s top 25 foods in the state if you ain't any good!

Name: Fresh donuts!!!
Description:
Awesome little bakery to take a break at. THE BEST donut you will ever have. The super nice baker told us she makes them throughout the day (we had warm ones). Can't remember exactly how much they were but definitely no more than $1.50/2 and they are large.

Price is 2$/ donut

Name: Awesome Russian Shop
Description: Russian Shop with european specialities. Awesome sausages, bread, groceries, vegetables, etc.

Location: Euro Foods and Deli, United States
Name: Euro Foods and Deli
Description:
European Store, Good german-style bread, Fish, sausages and meat, chocolate

Schwaben: SPÄTZLE!!!

Location: Mama's Garden Stand & Beef, United States
Name: Mama's Garden Stand & Beef
Description:
Lots of different locally grown vegetables and fruit. Quite the variety! It was a great place to stock up for camping. Farm fresh eggs, too. Cash or check only. No cards.

Beef sales are only open on Friday 3-7pm & Saturdays 10am-2pm.

They have a sandbox and dumptruck-style toys for kids, if you need a break from driving.

Location: Battle Born Batteries/ Dragonfly Energy, United States
Name: Battle Born Batteries/ Dragonfly Energy
Description: Lithium batteries drop-in style for easy replacement of agm batteries. Made in Reno! The owners are very nice guys, great customer service.

Name: MailStation
Description:
Amazingly helpful guy who can accept packages and hold them for you!

Great for last minute amazon orders before México.

Just email him first to set you up for an account and it’s something pathetically small like $1/package. Legend

http://www.missionhillsmailstation.com/

Name: the computer doctor
Description: excellent and honest computer repairs in Del Rio, can call ahead and get the right parts ordered if necessary, process went very smoothly

Name: Fields Station
Description: General store. food. pit toilets . gas, diesel and propane. RV pump out and water. ($19).

Name: Don José Panaderia
Description:
Mexican bakery, it is worth visiting, a lot of different types of baked goods. Some limited groceries like sodas, onions, garlic.

Water jug fill station outside that's signed for 30c per gallon, not sure if it works.

Name: Geraldo‘s meat market
Description: Very nice people doing jugos naturales and sandwiches in best quality - I recommend.

Name: Molokai Livestock CoOp
Description: Great place to get grass fed beef. Can also get venison.

Name: Glazier's Market
Description: grocery store - meat produce bakery deli - family owned

Name: Clark’s Supermarket
Description: Good supermarket, plenty of fresh produce. A reverse osmosis water filter is outside, 1 gallon 35 cents, 5 gallons US$1.75

Location: Mormon Lake Country Store, United States
Name: Mormon Lake Country Store
Description: A few groceries, a few souvenirs, a little hardware, some camping supplies and some fishing tackle. Coffee and snacks too. There is a Lodge and restaurant that are seasonal. Close to The Arizona Trail.

Name: District Bicycles
Description: An awesome bicycle shop for all your cycling needs. Incredible off road / gravel bike supplies, shop. One stop for all your cycling needs.

Name: Terry’s Food & Drug
Description: A rare place to buy groceries at decent price between the Mighty Fives.

Name: office Max
Description: Road map book made of paper! Took all morning to locate Great

Name: Bread alone
Description: If you want to eat/buy a REAL bread again, this is the place to go. Dark crispy bread, French baguette and much more. And excellent coffee too. We loved it

Location: Mission Mountains Mercantile / Sinclair Fuel, United States
Name: Mission Mountains Mercantile / Sinclair Fuel
Description: I was recommended by a local. “best sandwiches” He wasn’t kidding - this place is like a mini Whole Foods with a Deli , outside seating , fuel and ATM. No WiFi. Verizon lame. ATT LTE 1 bar. no dogs allowed on front porch, but there is a picnic table to the left of the building - nice place to have lunch

Name: General Store
Description: Here's the general store to get some souvenirs with a wall at the front to slap your sticker on it. Now turn around and head back south.

Location: Haines Packing Co Wild Alaska Salmon, United States
Name: Haines Packing Co Wild Alaska Salmon
Description: With a shop selling all kind of local seafood, also in season fresh offers, open 10 am to 6 pm

Location: Wayne County Information Center, United States
Name: Wayne County Information Center
Description: Gives excellent information and very nice lady!

Name: Library
Description: great public library and only free WiFi in talkeetna.

Location: Seward Community Library Museum, United States
Name: Seward Community Library Museum
Description:
free wifi, medium to fast, but outside is less reliable.
no password. Printing facilities.

Name: Delta Junction Library
Description:
fFee good wifi, but not secure. no password.

Behind the Library is a gravel place, there is no sign so we stayed overnight, quiet, pit toilets not far at a sports ground

Name: Eureka
Description: Library with strong Wifi, even outside the library . NO OVERNIGHTS

Name: Library South Tahoe
Description: Library with the fastest free internet we ever had on this trip so far. You can use a computer for 1/2 hour for free. They can print (15 cents per Page) and you can scan documents.

Location: La Quinta Public Library, United States
Name: La Quinta Public Library
Description: Free WiFi, desktop computer use. Copies 15¢. Big, new library, with covered parking (9ft or so and under).

Location: free Wifi at Cannon Beach Visitor Center, United States
Name: free Wifi at Cannon Beach Visitor Center
Description: free good wifi at Cannon Beach Visitor Center, parking for RV nearby

Location: Free Wifi at visitor center, United States
Name: Free Wifi at visitor center
Description: Free Wifi at visitor center / restroom / nice view!! Wifi may only be available during open hours.

Location: Bend Public Library WI-FI, United States
Name: Bend Public Library WI-FI
Description: Excellent public library, fast free WiFi, restrooms... also very nice place for kids to play. Parking lot across the street for free and unlimited hours. Great! No Overnights

Location: Liabrary with free wifi, United States
Name: Liabrary with free wifi
Description: We needed to print (20c per piece) n scan which they did. Free wifi also had a book sale 3 for $1. Some Good finds

Name: Public Library - Wifi
Description: Free and fast wifi at the public library. Also, they had a full table of free books when we were here.

Name: Soldotna Library
Description: Great WiFi. Fireplace from Oct to May. Quiet place to relax. Very new.

Location: Tri Valley Library, fast wifi, United States
Name: Tri Valley Library, fast wifi
Description: Fast wifi, nice staff, laptop-friendly. Opening times very limited over winter though so check them beforehand!

Location: Colter Bay General Store, United States
Name: Colter Bay General Store
Description:
Water in front of the general store.
Left side from the store entrance, blue picture with a moose.
only bottle fillings not RV's.
Wi-Fi, no password needed, accessible at picnic tables in front of store and picnic tables at the side in the shade of the trees.

Location: Chair9 / Blue T lodge, United States
Name: Chair9 / Blue T lodge
Description: Has wifi, but you will need the password. This is the only wifi I could find in Glacier area. Also has gluten free pizza!

Name: Hanksville Free Wifi
Description: Very good wifi at the Medical Clinic. No password required. Covered seating

Name: Broken Bow Library
Description: Really nice and new library. Free and fast WiFi!

Location: Mono public Library WiFi, United States
Name: Mono public Library WiFi
Description: There is WiFi available at this library 24/7, whether open or closed! You can park outside and still get WiFi, and across the street in the parking lot there are outlets to plug in for electricity!

Name: Marathon Library
Description:
Cute, very tiny, library with free fast WiFi! Hours are 1-6 during week, closed on Sat-Sun.

But WiFi can be reached in parking lot when closed and is fast.

AND: we asked about overnighting at Peña Park, librarian said not anymore...but just park here! And the groundskeeper filled our water tank!

Location: Carl’s Jr. Free WiFi, United States
Name: Carl’s Jr. Free WiFi
Description: Carl’s Jr. has great free WiFi accessible from their parking lot! Solid signal and fast service, and no signs in parking lot limiting time or disallowing you to park here. Great, easy place to get WiFi!

Name: Fireplace and wifi
Description: Chill little house with couches, tables, wifi and power outlets. can play some boardgames while you dump your SD cards or charge your stuff.

Location: Borrego Springs Public Library, United States
Name: Borrego Springs Public Library
Description: Borrego Springs Public Library has lots of parking, clean bathrooms and lightning fast Wifi (no password). They recently rebuilt it and it is beautiful. They’re open Tuesday to Saturday from 9:30 a.m. Wednesday and Thursday night they close at 8 p.m.

Location: Clarkdale Park WiFi and restrooms, United States
Name: Clarkdale Park WiFi and restrooms
Description: This park is one block from laundromat, post office and restaurants. Park includes children’s play area, grassy shade, picnic tables, clean restrooms and free WiFi. Overnight parking is probably not possible due to city rules.

Location: Fast WiFi - Visitor Information Center, United States
Name: Fast WiFi - Visitor Information Center
Description:
Fast WiFi outside the Information Center. No plugs for your device though.
Get the password inside.

Name: Library Bozeman
Description: Amazing big library. Good WiFi, working area, clean restrooms. Open everyday from 10-8 Saturday 10/5

Location: Free WiFi in Parking Lot of Lone Tree Arts Center, United States
Name: Free WiFi in Parking Lot of Lone Tree Arts Center
Description: There’s a library next door with free WiFi too, though it wasn’t open when I needed to do a video conference. The north side parking at the Arts Center had great WiFi.

Name: Wifi - Ashford public
Description:
We didn’t have network with AT&T, but there was free Wifi in town. And it worked !
These coordinates lead you to the fire station, but it might be stronger elsewhere.

Name: MacDonald's - Moab
Description: If you need free Wifi you can park your motorhome in the parking lot and get a good signal. We used the service so we ate here. We can park our 26 feet rv without problems. Just in front of the entrance you can park your vehicle under the tree without disturbing the MacDonald parking.

Name: Library WiFi
Description: FREE WiFi at the Public Library Skagway... Don't need password!

Location: The Wayward Traveler's Inn, United States
Name: The Wayward Traveler's Inn
Description: The Wayward Traveler's Inn, Bed and Breakfast, Tea House, Writer's Retreat and General House of Awesomeness. Run by a writer and avid motorcyclist, we will give any great trekker up to two nights free accommodation. That's how important supporting the travel community is to us.

Name: Super 8 Motel, Nephi
Description: We got a huge room with two queen size beds. Everything was clean. Breakfast included and free WiFi.

Name: Days Inn SeaWorld/Airport
Description: Small but clean double room with free WiFi and breakfast for $57. About 800m to the train station.

Name: Motel 6, San Ysidro
Description: Nothing special but room was clean and cheap. Close to the border and there is a huge mall in walking distance. WiFi in the room costs $3 extra.

Location: Red Rock Country Inn, United States
Name: Red Rock Country Inn
Description:
Nondescript Motel in Kanab. In low season we were able to get a double room for 55.00. Apparently in high season (starting in May) the room would cost 130.!!
There are many RV resorts and campgrounds in this town but since last night the temperature was in the low single digits (C) we decided on hot showers and a heated room.

Name: Moorings at Carrabelle
Description: Great accommodations at the marina. inexpensive and accepts pets.

Name: Americano Motel
Description:
If you should find yourself in Vaughn New Mexico and night is approaching, this clean but dated motel is acceptable, relatively inexpensive accomodations.
The pool is inoperable but the rooms are spacious with two double beds, hot shower , mini fridge and microwave. They have airconditioning and heat. Next door there is a 24 hour diner (and much more expensive motel)
We parked our motorcycle right outside our window. $55US + tax for two people

Location: Shoshone-Bannock Hotel & Event Center, United States
Name: Shoshone-Bannock Hotel & Event Center
Description:
Hotel, Casino, Bingo.

Great facility. Good food, very reasonable prices. All Staff extremely friendly & helpful. Clean as in New. Hotel 5 yrs old at time of writing.

Will stay here again.

Location: Tha Station's Inn Motorcycle Resort, United States
Name: Tha Station's Inn Motorcycle Resort
Description:
Just off the Blue Ridge Pky. Hotel, restaurant and small store. Live music on weekends. $75/night for solo traveler.

No wifi in rooms but, strong near restaurant. Covered parking.

Name: Cedar Rest Motel
Description: Great budget motel dor travellers and families! One of the cheapest in the area but strongly recommended! Great place to stay when you want to visit Bryce Canyon and around. Very clean, fresh, renewed. Very kind owners from Fiji. AC, great internet, microwave, TV and fridge. Close to the shops, laundry and gastronomic places. Safe big parking, even for RVs. Breakfast in the morning. 45$ for two people.

Location: America's Best Value Inn, United States
Name: America's Best Value Inn
Description: Nice, clean rooms. Best price in town. We checked several hotels/ motels. the Motel 6 wanted to charge $130! This place was $99. Staff is very kind. They are pet friendly.

Name: MOTEL Majestic Rockies
Description: Great and not so expensive place to stay in the city. Motel with every convenience. Tv, sat, wi-fi inside, AC, parking, heating, big beds, bathroom, fridge and hot water. Very clean and comfortable. Near you have a gas station and Subway. The small room for two I called for pricing and was told $350.00 weekly.

Name: Econolodge, Limon
Description: very clean. great price. nice staff. right off the highway.

Name: McCarthy Lake
Description: lakeside campgrounds within Manistee National Forest. Please follow all National Forest rules. High clearance 4x4 recommended, can become crowded on weekends. please don't burn pallets or wood with steel straps.

Name: Hilton Hotel
Description:
Super clean hotel, very comfortable beds, great water pressure in the shower. Pet friendly, they even gave my dog a treat bag with a toy and treats in it! Large campers (earth roamer etc.) would fit in the back of the hotel parking lot, but if you had a large rig with a trailer you might have to park someplace else.

Great location for doing the TWVT, or a stop on your way south to the KAT or Overland Expo East. Google maps had strange directions coming I-77 south, it wanted me to pass the exit and come back North? It's the Mineral Wells exit, you can see the sign from I-77.

Name: 1st Travel Inn
Description: pride in ownership in this older hotel. my room was spotless and updated. $52us for a single. nicest room I've ever had at this price.

Location: Caesar‘s Palace Las Vegas, United States
Name: Caesar‘s Palace Las Vegas
Description:
The very famous Caesar‘s Palace.

The reason why I put it on here is that they have really good valet parking. Safe and no hight restriction. Self parking is 14ft.

Other than that: enjoy, gamble hard, drink and visit Omnia nightclub.

By the way: Caesar didn’t live there. I asked.

Name: Travelodge
Description: Great staff. Nice location in Yuba City Ca

Name: Desert Hills Motel
Description: Big place with lots of parking no matter what size vehicles. Big rooms for about $50 a night, king size bed, air con, cable tv, fridge/freezer and hot water etc. bit of a luxyry compared to my experience in south america but good value and on historic route 66 too! wiifi is the phone number.

Name: The remerhotel
Description: Friendly clean reasonably priced close to gas and food

Name: Manago Hotel
Description: A very basic accommodation. 45usd two beds with shared toilets (which are reasonably clean). Or 73usd with private toilet , all private rooms have small balconies facing ocean. Rooms only have fan and wifi is free. This place has over 100 year old restaurant on premises which serves delicious food (mains in range of 12-15usd), pancakes are huge fluffy size of a side plate worth trying. There is also a taco truck down the road, few fruit shops and supermarket 10 minutes of walking distance. We stayed here 3 nights on the way back from overland trip in usa. Having a rental car made it convenient as 20 minutes to kona where we dived and few snorkeling places within 10 minutes of drive. Volcano np is 2 hours drive towards hilo but it was closed due to hightened activity. Nice drive.

Location: Great Plains Bunk House, United States
Name: Great Plains Bunk House
Description: Great place to stay right on the TransAmerica Trail, right before exiting Oklahoma. Owners are kind and accommodating. Rooms are themed and comfortable. $70 a night for a room. They also allow camping on their property. Has a park for kids to play.

Location: Modern Hotel and Bar, United States
Name: Modern Hotel and Bar
Description: Updated retro motel in downtown Boise, ID.

Name: Scottish Motel
Description: Nothing special, but we wanted to live the “motel experience” before leaving the country. 60$ + tax for a double room. We cried a little and they accepted just 60$. The room was clean.

Name: Motel 6
Description: Very clean, modern and cheap motel, just off interstate highway.

Name: The flute shop
Description:
Very friendly and nice couple having native souvenirs shop and a little motel. Room for 50 usd availible :)
Totally recommended!

Name: Denio Junction
Description: Small motel, cafe, fuel, bar, & RV park.

Name: Gulfway Motel
Description: Small motel with clean rooms free wifi fridges and microwaves

Name: Budget Inn
Description: $43 including all taxes for a single, strong Wi-Fi, clean, friendly and well lit parking.

Name: Antelope Lodge
Description: Fairly basic cabins but each is self contained, with parking. Good hot shower, fast WiFi, TV, cooker. $80 a night but the weather was freezing and we were stuck so we were happy to pay.

Name: Thurston's lobster
Description: Good place for a lobster sandwich (we preferred the grilled cheese over the roll), some drinks and wifi while looking over the harbor. This area is more off the beaten path and is nothing like bar harbor.

Name: Backslope brewing
Description: In a industry now over saturated in mediocrity this brewery stands out. Great beers at a cheap price $4, and very good food. (Try the ginger pork sand which with fries ($10). This place is very good and should be visited while you come and go from Glacier. Stands apart from most/all of the other Montana breweries we've been too!

Name: Mandarin Gourmet
Description:
Chinese restaurant.
All you can eat for 7,99$
Good price for value.

Name: Rusty Bike
Description:
Home cooked food. Local favorite.

Owner is an avid motorcylist with plenty of good advice on riding the Tail of the Dragon.

Location: The Ohana Family Cafe, United States
Name: The Ohana Family Cafe
Description: A must-stop. The best small-town America experience we've had to date... Excellent pulled pork, delicious BBQ sauce and a delightful variety of yummy pies. The staff and owners are lovely and made us feel extraordinarily welcome. On top of bottomless cups of coffee, there is reasonably fast wifi (no mobile service here). Highly recommend: Roel (from Holland): "The best place I've eaten at in the US." :) Lots of free wild camping options between here and the Very Large Array.

Name: Mazama Country Store
Description: Country store with a deli and coffee house. Great bakery items.

Name: Astoria Pier 39
Description:
TOP!!!
Wonderful place on the water with a nice beer bar „rogue“ with great cheep food and a lovely cafe - „coffee girl“ - we stayed here overnight on the street - quiet - no problems
and we had many sea lions on the pier -
so nice to see them sooo close :)

Name: Wheat Montana bakery
Description: exit 274 on I 90. deli, coffee, etc. Your sweet tooth serviced here.

Name: Schat’s Bakery
Description: Good bread :) lots of good food, fresh orange juice, ...

Name: Bisbee breakfast club
Description: Great place for American breakfast. Not a greasy spoon. Parking for big rigs

Location: Alps Haus Cafe in Marleeville, United States
Name: Alps Haus Cafe in Marleeville
Description: GREAT place for a breakfast burrito or lunch! They have WiFi. Across the street is a public water bottle filling station. Very welcoming to a traveler.

Name: Burrito Del Sol
Description: Really good Baja style tacos. Possibly best in Florida. Only street parking available. Dogs welcome for outside seating.

Location: Joshua Tree - Crossroads Cafe, United States
Name: Joshua Tree - Crossroads Cafe
Description: $5 beers and generous mimosas. Ruben excellent, can’t miss cappuccino! Pancakes YES!!

Location: Kiva Koffehouse & Kiva Kottage, United States
Name: Kiva Koffehouse & Kiva Kottage
Description:
Very nice coffee place with organic products, fresh coffee and a variety of drinks and food like breakfast or salads or gluten-free pasta... it’s up on a hill so the view is gorgeous and it is lovely outside for a warm day. We really enjoyed stopping here and we recommend it !

Open Wed-Sun 8-4pm

Location: Paradise bar and grill, United States
Name: Paradise bar and grill
Description: best food we've had in weeks. open air bar and restaurant... decent prices, live music, nice bartenders, clean bathrooms. had a blackened mahi basket,(12.95) smuggled in our own booze and stayed in the parking lot right on the water. even a tiny dog park here too but no dogs in the bar. "no dogs" seems to be the Mantra for Pensacola beach sadly. enjoy!

Name: Ziggy's Roadside BBQ
Description: This is a simple place where you order at the counter then seat yourself, but they serve up the best BBQ we've ever had. I was worried when the meal came served on a foam plate with plastic utensils, but the the ribs, the brisket, and turkey were all so tender they fell apart with the lightest touch of the fork. The BBQ sauce had the perfect balance of tartness and. sweetness, and we ended up with a plate full of perfection. This place is a "must stop if you like BBQ!

Name: Crawfishtown USA
Description: This place is a gem! Roadside crawfish with awesome service and RV park in the rear!

Name: Steamies Burger Bar
Description:
In the little touristy town of Telluride.

Burgers start at 5.95$/7.95$double and fries start at 3.95$

Burger was really food but the fries were pretty bad(being nice)

Location: Sunsets West Co-op Eatery, United States
Name: Sunsets West Co-op Eatery
Description: Nice little food co-operative with organic coffee & home made food. A bistro in a small town (next to great haircuts), and down the road from the public library. WIFI

Name: Foothills Cafe
Description: Great breakfast (and lunch?) spot outside of Yosemite. HUGE portions of tastey food, very reasonable prices.

Name: Rogues Garden, Valdez
Description: Great cafe & shop with alternative health products, deli products, fresh fruit and vegetables and delicious coffee, cakes, breads, snacks etc, some veggie, vegan and gluten free.

Name: Chez Jacqueline
Description:
Very nice family. Cajun restaurant. 18$ per plate. Great place.

Closed on Tuesdays

Name: Creekside Cafe & Lodging
Description:
I can’t comment on the Lodging as I didn’t stay, but the cafe is great and the baked goods exemplary. Everything is baked on the premises and the Cinnamon buns are to die for!
Cinnamon bun (Texas size) & hot chocolate $9.50

Name: Burr Trail Outpost
Description: Cool place! Water, free WiFi, good food, a place to sit and hang out in the shade (or in the warmth in winter when it's - 6C and snow outside! ). What else do you need?

Name: Stan's
Description: Best burgers and fries with special sauce. Shakes are their forte. Don't ask me how they make them like this. You just have to see it yourself! An oasis in a barren land.

Location: North Fork Beer Shrine & Pizzeria, United States
Name: North Fork Beer Shrine & Pizzeria
Description: Brewery & Food. Wi-Fi. Good local beer, cider, wine & tasty pizza. They have Gluten free pizza, as well. There are other menu offerings, too, including salads and grinders/sandwiches. In the entry hall there are great free maps of the area.

Location: Coffee Pot, Home of the 101 Omelettes, United States
Name: Coffee Pot, Home of the 101 Omelettes
Description: Nice and cheap place for a breakfast! They have 101 different Omelettes ;), Pancakes, and much more! Great for a special breakfast time when you have enough from oatmeal every morning ;)

Name: Carniceria Terra Caliente
Description: Delicious Mexican food in Parker, AZ, also food and camping supplies such as charcoal

Name: Kanab Creek Bakery
Description:
French Bakery with original amazing french bread, sweets, breakfast and all the delicious foods!!!! Nice friendly stuff and french master chef :)
Best bakery we found in the states!!!

Name: Bruno's Country Club
Description: Don't be fooled by the name, Bruno's is not your usual pretentious "country club". lt's a down home cafe & bar with great food.

Name: The Living Room
Description: This is a the view point at the en of a great little hike near the U. Of Utah. Follow the trail to red butte peak and you'll see the trail cut off to this viewpoint.

Location: Allegheny National Forest Ranger Station, United States
Name: Allegheny National Forest Ranger Station
Description:
Allegheny National Forest Ranger Station - info on camping

https://www.fs.usda.gov/detail/allegheny/about-forest/offices

Name: CamAmboyCrater
Description: Nice space at the trail to the crater, tables, pit toilets, free.

Name: Escalante rest area
Description:
tables, bbqs, reasons, drinking water near a gas station and grocery store.
nice playground for kids

Name: Children's park
Description: for those traveling with kids, this is a great place to stop and get out some energy on some great playground equipment and toys. close to the border, new park that was completely deserted :)

Name: Bealtiful beach
Description: Only a day use, until 11 p.m.

Location: Hobo Hot Springs (& Showers by Donation) Saratoga, United States
Name: Hobo Hot Springs (& Showers by Donation) Saratoga
Description:
Hot pools, free use, open 24 hours. The bath house is complete with showers and restroom facilities (although the restrooms have no doors, at least on the ladies' side).

No potable water, so bring your own.

Pools range from extremely hot (116°) to pretty cool (100°). Daily temps written on board at bath house. Swimsuits required.

http://saratogachamber.info/play-here/things-to-do/mineral-hot-springs/

Name: Holtville Hot Springs (camping)
Description:
This is a FREE hot springs with two or three pools and a shower. Frequented by area campers.
There is a parking lot with "no overnight" posted. But several areas nearby where overnight parking would not be noticed. Just check the dirt roads nearby and along the canal. There is also a campground across the street but we did not check details.
The hot spring parking area has pit toilets, concrete surrounding, shade, seating. Used all day and through the night. Bring flashlights at night.
This is alongside Hwy 8 at Vanderlinden Exit. This is accessible by all vehicles.

Name: Kelso Dunes
Description: One of the oldest and most extensive dune fields in the West. Famous for their sound.

Name: Montezuma Castle
Description: Montezuma Castle National Monument

Location: Silver City Visitor Center, United States
Name: Silver City Visitor Center
Description: Moderator Note: Overnight parking/camping is NOT available at this location. Please read recent Check-Ins. Obey all signage. Respect the wishes of the locals.

Location: Gila Cliff Dwellings National Monument, United States
Name: Gila Cliff Dwellings National Monument
Description:
Free. Open 9-4. Two hour travel time from Silver City plus exploring, leave Silver City before 1 at the latest or don’t bother. Plenty of camping opportunities on the way.

Amazing place to see how people built structures inside Cliff Dweller Canyon's natural cave.

Location: Visitor Center White Sands National Monument, United States
Name: Visitor Center White Sands National Monument
Description: Beautiful Adobe building. Has an excellent museum. Restrooms and drinking water, sales (t-shirts, books, staff medallians, patches, etc). Entrance to dunes is further up the road and it will blow your mind.

Name: Film Museum
Description: Museum of Western Film History of the Alabama Hills and Lone Pine. $5 entry fee

Name: Spider Rock
Description: Spider Rock lookout is 100m from here. Large parking for all size vehicle, small track to walk out and see the STUNNING vista, with the Spider Rock monument. We were here in winter, it was snowing and absolutely magical. The roads are kept clear to drive with ease.

Name: Tavertine Hot Springs
Description:
NO OVERNIGHT CAMPING! Day use only!

Free Hot Springs
One pool at the parking, 4 pools around 100m behind the toilet.

Name: Bodie Ghost Town
Description:
Interesting ghost town from gold rush.
8$ pP
Opening hours:
Summer hours 9am-6pm (18.March - 31.October)
Winter hours 9am-4pm (1.November - 17.March)

Name: Astoria Colomn
Description: Beautiful 360 degree view. You can drive up there (5 $ for parking) or park below and walk up the hill.

Location: Mendocino Headlands State Park, United States
Name: Mendocino Headlands State Park
Description: Open 5 am to 10 pm. Free. Restrooms, water and drinking water available. Beautiful drive.

Name: Pahrump Valley Winery
Description:
Estate Winery. beautiful facilty. Free wine tasting - up to 7 wines.
Fine restaurant. reasonable prices on food & wines.

Tours available. Worth the drive from Vegas.

Name: China Ranch
Description:
Old Ranch - Date Farm - Antiques.
Out of the way but well worth the trip.
Fantastic date shakes!

Road paved for part of the way, the dirt/gravel road.

Lots of parking space. 9-5 most days

Name: Montezuma hot springs
Description:
many smal pools whith verry hot water 38-50 Grad C . A cold river byside to cool down. All for free.
no overnight s tanding. Closed form midnight to 5:00 am.

Name: Thunderbird conservation park
Description: Nice hiking trails. Also horseback riding trails. Great place to hang out and star gaze.

Location: Tail Of The Dragon/Deal's Gap, United States
Name: Tail Of The Dragon/Deal's Gap
Description:
Legendary motorcyle and sports car destination. More than 300 curves in 11-miles.

A bucket list road.

Name: Lower Antelope Canyon
Description:
Start of trail in the Lower Antelope Canyon. 75 dollars per person but it is worth it. It really amazing.
$40 each plus $8 (cash) to Navajos. Very busy. May check out other slot canyons for free.

Edit 05/2024 : around 75 pp (55 + 8 entry fees + taxes). Good idea to book online in advance (two operators : Dixie and Ken)

Name: 4 Corners Park
Description:
Farthest Northeast city in the US. If you're doing a 4-corners tour of the US, this is the place.

Nice park with photo-op monument, dedicated pavers and a small gift shop where you can buy souveniers

Free admission.

Location: Carlsbad Caverns - Visitor Center and Entrance, United States
Name: Carlsbad Caverns - Visitor Center and Entrance
Description:
This is the carlsbad caverns visitor center and the location where you enter the cave.
$15 usd (per person) to enter or by anual pass 80,00(one year) if are going to anothers national parks.

You can take an elevator down to the main cave, or you can do a hike through the natural entrance. The hike in and out takes you 750ft. up/down in about a mile, but it's a comfortable hike in the cool cave temperature.
beautiful caves, very developed with lights and trails, but amazing none the less!

Location: Wave community recreation center, United States
Name: Wave community recreation center
Description: Super nice community center. very nice private (curtain) clean showers, pool, gym, steam room, etc wifi w good lobby and lounge area. $5

Location: Vermillion Cliffs Historical Marker, United States
Name: Vermillion Cliffs Historical Marker
Description: Good roadside pulloff area, 100m from highway. great views of the cliffs.

Location: Skyline Drive easy walking trail, United States
Name: Skyline Drive easy walking trail
Description: Limberlost trail. Easy walking in the beautiful Skyline Drive, VA.

Location: San Isidro Currency Exchange, United States
Name: San Isidro Currency Exchange
Description: Money Exchange in McAllen. Perfect to get Mexican pesos before Crossing the border

Name: IBC bank
Description: IBC bank into the Walmart. if you are not a customer, you can use the ATM machine to get US cash and after that you go at the cashier to get Pesos.

Name: Glacier Bank
Description: Glacier bank of Libby. ATM's here and a big parking. 1 minute from Main Street.

Name: Honor credit union
Description: This is a credit union and has an atm. There also is a drive thru there

Name: Cambio Express
Description: Currency exchange, right before border crossing

Location: Memorial Hospital of Salem County NJ, United States
Name: Memorial Hospital of Salem County NJ
Description: A quality Hospital with Cooper doctors. free parking and friendly staff

Name: Danbury Hospital
Description: Level 2 trauma center. ER entrance is in the back of the hospital off Hospital Ave right before an open field. there is limited outside parking which is usually filled by midday but there is a parking garage with 7'-0" clearance. There are also some smaller parking lots across the street. valet parking is available. Ambulances use same driveway to drop off patients so keep an eye out for ambulances coming in and out. their drop of area is past the ER parking lot.

Name: Cortez Family Dentistry
Description:
We stopped here during our travels because one of our children has cavities.
The dentist and his crew were friendly and competent.
We recommend this place.
115 N Beech Street Cortez
Tel: 970 565 72 75

Name: Moab Hospital
Description:
If you need a a doctor you can go here.
After an accident in mountain bike we needed to get a doctor for a chin scar....
Friendly crew.
Quick service...
Go to the Urgent Care, not to the emergency.
I hope you don't need it.

Name: Anchorage Heath Department
Description: Clinica médica publica no es necesario seguro de salud. Pediatría y atención primaria. Muy economico. Vacunación

Location: Pediatric Dentistry - Great Falls, United States
Name: Pediatric Dentistry - Great Falls
Description: They received us immediately to fix 2 cavities on my son. Very professional. I recommend.

Name: Houston Medical Center
Description: Parking lot: $7 per day. Has shuttles to hospitals in the medical center.

Location: Baylor Scott & White Hospital, United States
Name: Baylor Scott & White Hospital
Description: 24 hr emergency. Full service hospital with many specialists. Regional referral center.

Location: Miss Lou Family Dentistry, United States
Name: Miss Lou Family Dentistry
Description:
Dental practice that works to accommodate travelers.

While passing through Natchez I wound up with a bad gum infection. These fine folks got me in on New Year's Eve for x-rays and an exam and was able to pull my tooth first thing on January 2nd. I would recommend to all fellow travelers in need.

Location: Mayo Clinic Health System - Austin, United States
Name: Mayo Clinic Health System - Austin
Description: Hospital and Clinic and Emergency Department and Urgent Care.

Name: Sunnyside Cannabis Dispensary
Description: Medical and adult use marijuana . 9 to 9

Name: Deaconess Hospital
Description: Level 2 Trauma Hospital with Emergency Room. Pediatrics and Pregnant Women can be seen for emergencies but if admission required, may need to be transferred to another hospital that provides services. Available services include: Stroke. Cardiac. MRI. X-Ray. Nuclear Medicine. Ultrasound. Lab. Cafeteria available till midnight.

Name: Deaconess Gateway Hospital
Description: Emergency Department. Stroke. Cardiac. Pediatrics. Women’s OB/GYN. Lab. X-Ray. Ultrasound. CT. Nuclear Medicine. Oncology. If patient requires trauma services/admission, Gateway is able to stabilize and transfer to appropriate trauma certified hospital.

Name: Urgent Care
Description: Urgent care. You can reserve a spot online.

Name: Norton hospital
Description: So I am traveling cross country in my car and I ended up with some sharp pains in my chest, came to this hospital and have been given the best treatment I have ever gotten in my 41 years of living . I know this is not about camping but if you need a doctor or need some medical attention this is the place to go .. I really hope to be getting back on the road soon. somehow I got a hole in my lung and a pneumonia.

Name: La Grande Hospital
Description: A decent hospital, we had a case of food poisoning while staying at Morgan Lake and drove here for help

Name: Beloit Memorial Hospital
Description: Full service hospital with emergency room.

Name: Dennis Schulze, DDS
Description: We've been using this Dentist for over 12 years and they have a great staff and have modified hours to allow for visits. They take all types of insurance and also have self-pay. See their website for hours. Close proximity to Hwy 64/40. The parking will hold a campervan but anything larger may have to park at a business next door.

Name: Mayo Clinic -Jacksonville
Description:
9 RV parking spots - located in Lot A next to Courtyard by Marriott.
No overnight parking in Lot A but a great spot if you need a hospital. Beautiful hospital campus with many places to walk, Starbucks and cafeteria. (also seems to be pet-friendly)
4500 San Pablo Rd. S Jacksonville FL 33224

Location: Jackson Lodge Medical Clinic, United States
Name: Jackson Lodge Medical Clinic
Description: Jackson Lodge medical clinic also gas, restrooms and potable water

Name: Marquette Hospital
Description: This is the hospital and the emergency room. There are other doctors offices too

Name: Bell Hospital
Description: This is Bell Hospital and emergency room and there are other doctors offices in the building

Name: Geisinger Medical Center
Description: Level 1 Trauma, Stroke, and Heart center. All advanced medical care available.

Name: Sanford Hospital
Description: Hospital/ ER/ Clinic/ Pharmacy. Public restrooms, Free coffee, Free filtered water fountains. Cafeteria food for purchase, open to public.

Location: Urgent Care doctor inside market, United States
Name: Urgent Care doctor inside market
Description: Had a really bad rash and was sent here by some locals. The doctor's office is in the back of the store and he gives 75$ consultations. Next pharmacy is in Forks. More convenient than driving all the way to Port Angeles to the next urgent care. (360) 640-5601 (I forget the doctors name.)

Location: Miami Valley Hospital North, United States
Name: Miami Valley Hospital North
Description: Full service medical center with 24 hour emergency room. Parking is limited. Large vehicles should use the overflow lot on the Eastside of the campus.

Name: St Luke's Hospital
Description: Great Hospital has Urgent Care and ER. Urgent care entrance is to your left as you come in main hospital entrance.

Name: Norwalk Hospital
Description: Local trauma center. Full service hospital with emergency room and 24/7 availability.

Name: Bernardo Veterinary
Description:
Friendly vet for dog check before entering Mexico. Offered text consultations for emergencies while we are on the road.
We walked in without an appointment and our doggie was taken care of immediately

Location: Best dog park ever!, United States
Name: Best dog park ever!
Description: Awesome dog park! Right next to the river, huuuuge space super lovely!!

Location: Sudz unleashed self service dog wash, United States
Name: Sudz unleashed self service dog wash
Description: self service dog wash, $10/10 minutes. In the back behind the muffler shop .

Location: Self service Pet wash at the Rapid Wash Car Wash, United States
Name: Self service Pet wash at the Rapid Wash Car Wash
Description: 5 dollars for 5 minutes. bring your own towel

Location: Malibu Coast Animal Hospital and Legacy Park, United States
Name: Malibu Coast Animal Hospital and Legacy Park
Description: Animal Hospital and access to Legacy Park. Good place to take a break and walk dogs. Street parking HWY 1 or park at Civic Center Way. There is also a Country Mart for shopping.

Location: Happy trail dog park, United States
Name: Happy trail dog park
Description:
Great dog park... free!

Most dog parks in the area require a pass to get in involving a fee and providing vaccination records. This is a normal dog park without all that... beautiful park

Location: Devon Dog Park and Greenland Open Space, United States
Name: Devon Dog Park and Greenland Open Space
Description: Devon Dog Park Fantastic off the leash dog park right next to GreenLand Open Space , with a Trailhead for hiking, riding horses Xcoountry skiing , mountain biking , have a b-q. It is close to the highway and a railroad tracks, good place to take dog out , get fresh water , stretch your legs. Has super oversized pit toilets . Not sure if you can stay overnight call the number on website , I’m sure if you got in late and kept quiet for a night no one would care , people were super nice

Name: Ortiz Dog Park
Description: This dog park is over 100 acres of trails, and land for your dog to roam freely. It is an off leash dog park (you can still leash your dog) with no fence but clear perimeters of where the park ends. This is a must go to with your dog, the views from the trails are insane and your dog will make lots of friends! It’s open from 6AM-10PM and has an amazing view of the sunset.

Name: Walton Rocks
Description: Awesome dog beach along Florida’s east coast. It is really hard to find anywhere to take your dog to the beach along this coast but this one is great. It is also an OFF LEASH beach so your dog can run and play with friends, play some fetch or go for a swim in the ocean. What a great place for the dogs.

Location: Woof Bowl Dog Park, United States
Name: Woof Bowl Dog Park
Description: Small fenced dog park behind the football field in the Roswell Sports Complex. Lots of parking, expansive parking lot.

Name: Dog park
Description: Great good sized dog park. No fee to get in.

Name: Dog park
Description: Great large dog park... it’s behind the church

Location: Village of Ruidoso Dog Park, United States
Name: Village of Ruidoso Dog Park
Description:
Two fenced areas on a slope with trees for shade and many nice benches to rest on. The people were very friendly and attentive of their dogs. There was hardly any poop on the ground, either!
There’s also an area of blue bins to drop off recycling, right there in the parking lot.

Location: Las Cruces Dog Park, United States
Name: Las Cruces Dog Park
Description: There are two areas for dogs at this dog park. One smaller area for “special needs” dogs and a large area for all others. There is no grass, but the dogs don’t seem to mind. This is one of the best dog parks I’ve taken my pooch to. It’s maintained by a coalition of members who care about this park, and it shows. Very little, if any, poop to watch out for, lots of trees and shade, benches and chairs galore, water buckets with fresh water all over, and even a big light if you need to come after dark!

Location: Dog Park NOLA City Park, United States
Name: Dog Park NOLA City Park
Description:
If you travel with your dog, this is a great place to visit. The park is separated into areas: one for big dogs and one for small dogs.
My dogs loved it. Several people come here daily to play with their dogs freely. Good place to make good friends.
Payed U$10 for one week in the administration of the park.
Clean bathrooms and a place to bath the dogs.
